title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
title_zh: Tev：通过密集进度奖励扩展长时程智能体环境

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously—from hours to days—on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym , the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards— 1,170 1{,}170 verified task environments across 7 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world : a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev -27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents’ Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.
paragraphs.zh: 长期规划智能体因其能够在经济价值高的任务中自主工作数小时甚至数天的能力而日益受到关注，这种能力对于自动化发现和递归自我改进（RSI）至关重要。 然而，开源模型在执行长期任务时仍存在困难，这主要归因于训练数据和有效方法的缺乏；而扩大这两者都充满挑战：长期复杂任务难以整理和验证，且其奖励信号稀疏。我们同时解决了这两个问题。 首先，我们提出了 Tev-Gym——首个用于长期规划智能体训练的数据集，它具备可验证、密集且渐进的奖励机制，涵盖 7 个领域的 1,170 个经过验证的任务环境。 该数据集基于一种“潜在世界优先”的方法构建：首先构造一个潜在世界，即任务领域、工作流程以及每一步预期状态的完整且正确的隐藏规范。 随后，每个任务都通过这一规范逐步渲染为面向智能体的环境，从而实现可控的复杂度和自然的进度衡量标准。 其次，我们将这一衡量标准转化为训练方法：通过“进度潜力奖励塑造”（PPRS），将进度转化为每一步的密集奖励，从而提升训练效率，并使原本难以处理的任务变得可训练。 使用该方法进行训练后，我们得到了 Tev-27B。它在“智能体最终考试”的计算与数学科学领域（ALE-CM）取得了显著提升，在 Pass@5 指标上达到了 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5 的水平。 尽管仅基于与 ALE 相关的数据进行训练，该模型仍能泛化到 Terminal-Bench（TB）3.0 和 4.0 子集，超越了 GLM 5.2 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash，并在 TB 2.1 等中期任务上达到了 Claude Opus 4.8 的性能水平。

paragraphs.en: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has shifted attention toward long-horizon agents ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026 ; Moonshot AI, 2026 ) , which can work autonomously for hours to days on complex, economically valuable tasks ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Styles et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) . Long-horizon tasks, such as solving open problems in mathematics and science, conducting automated machine learning research, and advancing coding and security systems, are fundamental to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI).
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展已将研究重点转向长时程智能体（OpenAI，2026；Anthropic，2026；Moonshot AI，2026），这类智能体能够自主工作数小时甚至数日，完成复杂且具有重要经济价值的任务（Sun 等，2026；Styles 等，2024；Zhu 等，2026a）。 长时程任务，例如解决数学和科学领域的开放性问题、开展自动化机器学习研究，以及推动编码和安全系统的进步，对于实现自动化发现与递归自我提升（RSI）至关重要。

sents.en: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has shifted attention toward long-horizon agents ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026 ; Moonshot AI, 2026 ) , which can work autonomously for hours to days on complex, economically valuable tasks ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Styles et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) .
sents.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展已将研究重点转向长时程智能体（OpenAI，2026；Anthropic，2026；Moonshot AI，2026），这类智能体能够自主工作数小时甚至数日，完成复杂且具有重要经济价值的任务（Sun 等，2026；Styles 等，2024；Zhu 等，2026a）。

sents.en: Long-horizon tasks, such as solving open problems in mathematics and science, conducting automated machine learning research, and advancing coding and security systems, are fundamental to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI).
sents.zh: 长时程任务，例如解决数学和科学领域的开放性问题、开展自动化机器学习研究，以及推动编码和安全系统的进步，对于实现自动化发现与递归自我提升（RSI）至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Despite these promising breakthroughs, coding-agent progress in the open-source community has focused on shorter- and mid-horizon tasks, scaled via large agentic training corpora such as SWE-Smith ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , TMAX ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) , Endless Terminals ( Gandhi et al., 2026 ) , CLI-Gym ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , SETA ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , and Terminal-Universe ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . These datasets contain thousands to tens of thousands of environments, but each involves only a pull-request-sized fix or a short terminal session, and their unit-test-based evaluation provides only a terminal pass/fail signal or the fraction of tests passed. By contrast, genuinely long-horizon tasks are available only in human-authored benchmarks ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . These benchmarks contain only tens to a few hundred instances, each requiring weeks of expert effort. They provide partial credit only through hand-written checkpoints and exist only as evaluation sets. Thus, no training corpus of long-horizon tasks exists: agentic training corpora are large but short-horizon, while long-horizon tasks exist only as small, human-authored evaluation sets.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些令人鼓舞的突破，开源社区中编码智能体的进展仍主要集中在短期和中期任务上，并通过大型智能体训练语料库（如 SWE-Smith (Yang et al., 2025a)、TMAX (Ivison et al., 2026)、Endless Terminals (Gandhi et al., 2026)、CLI-Gym (Lin et al., 2026)、SETA (Shen et al., 2026) 和 Terminal-Universe (Wu et al., 2026)）进行扩展。 这些数据集包含数千到数万的环境，但每个环境仅涉及一次拉取请求规模的修复或一个简短的终端会话，且基于单元测试的评估仅提供终端通过/失败信号或通过测试的比例。 相比之下，真正的长期任务仅存在于人类编写的基准测试中（Merrill et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026b）。 这些基准测试仅包含数十到数百个实例，每个实例都需要数周的专业人员努力才能完成。 它们只能通过人工书写的检查点提供部分分数，且仅作为评估集存在。 因此，目前并不存在任何长期任务的训练语料库：智能体训练语料库虽然规模庞大，但仅涵盖短期任务；而长期任务则仅以少量由人类编写的评估集形式存在。

paragraphs.en: Curating long-horizon tasks requires balancing two competing goals: tasks must be sufficiently long and structurally complex to provide meaningful training while remaining exactly verifiable ( Zeng et al., 2026a ) . Scaling long-horizon environments for training is even more difficult because rewards are sparse and available only upon task completion, depriving long-tail tasks of useful training signals. To address both limitations, we introduce a latent-world-first synthesis approach that begins by constructing a latent world , a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain. We first represent the underlying workflow as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) within a latent world and then progressively render the input files from that world. This procedure allows us to control task complexity while retaining every correct intermediate state, which provides a natural metric for measuring progress and therefore a verifiable dense reward for our training. Unlike pipelines that ask a language model to generate the task, inputs, and checker without a true answer, our latent world serves as an exact answer key for reliable verification.
paragraphs.zh: 设计长期任务需要在两个相互冲突的目标之间取得平衡：任务必须足够长且结构足够复杂，以提供有意义的训练，同时必须能够被精确验证（Zeng et al., 2026a）。 为训练而扩展长期环境甚至更加困难，因为奖励信号稀疏且仅在任务完成时才能获得，这使得长尾任务无法获得有用的训练信号。 为了应对这两种局限性，我们提出了一种“先构建潜在世界”的合成方法，该方法首先构造一个潜在世界——即任务域的完整且正确的隐藏规范。 我们首先在潜在世界中将底层工作流程表示为一个有向无环图（DAG），然后逐步从该世界中渲染输入文件。 这一过程使我们能够在控制任务复杂性的同时保留所有正确的中间状态，从而为衡量进展提供了自然指标，进而为我们的训练提供了可验证的密集奖励。 与那些要求语言模型生成任务、输入和检查器却没有真实答案的流程不同，我们的潜在世界可作为精确的答案库，以实现可靠的验证。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon tasks come with sparse rewards, arriving only at task completion and submission, which notoriously starves training on long-tail samples ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026a ) . Group-relative policy optimization ( Shao et al., 2024 , GRPO;) normalizes rewards within a group of G G rollouts of the same task, so under terminal-only reward, a group in which all G G rollouts fail has zero advantage everywhere and contributes nothing to the gradient. Mid-horizon pipelines can afford to discard such groups ( Ivison et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) because they are rare there; on long-horizon tasks they are most common at the start of training, when the policy is weakest and signal is needed most. We therefore introduce progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS) into reinforcement learning (RL), which makes training efficient and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. PPRS scores the agent’s workspace after every turn t t against the known-correct intermediate states from our latent world, giving a progress potential Φ ⁡ ( s t ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \Phi(s_{t})\in[0,1] that rises as the workflow is completed and falls on regressions. Reward shaped by Φ \Phi gives within-group variance from the first turn, even when no rollout finishes.
paragraphs.zh: 长期任务伴随着稀疏奖励，这些奖励仅在任务完成并提交时才会出现，而这种情况众所周知会导致长尾样本的训练资源严重不足（Yu et al., 2025；Shen et al., 2026；Zeng et al., 2026a）。 群体相对策略优化（Shao et al., 2024，GRPO）会将同一任务中 G 次 rollout 的奖励在群体内部进行归一化。因此，在仅存在终端奖励的情况下，如果一个群体中所有 G 次 rollout 都失败了，那么该群体在所有位置的优势值都为零，对梯度没有任何贡献。 中期流程可以舍弃这类群体（Ivison et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2025），因为它们在中期阶段较为罕见；而在长期任务中，这类群体在训练初期最为常见，此时策略最弱，最需要信号指导。 因此，我们将进展潜力奖励塑造（PPRS）引入强化学习（RL），这使得训练过程更加高效，并让原本难以处理的任务变得可训练。 PPRS 在每个回合 t 之后，都会将智能体的工作空间与来自我们潜在世界的已知正确中间状态进行比较，从而给出一个进展潜力 Φ(s_t) ∈ [0,1]；该值会随着工作流程的完成而上升，并在出现倒退时下降。 由 Φ 塑造的奖励即使在没有任何 rollout 完成的情况下，也能从第一个回合开始提供群体内部的方差。

sents.zh: 因此，我们将进展潜力奖励塑造（PPRS）引入强化学习（RL），这使得训练过程更加高效，并让原本难以处理的任务变得可训练。

sents.en: PPRS scores the agent’s workspace after every turn t t against the known-correct intermediate states from our latent world, giving a progress potential Φ ⁡ ( s t ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \Phi(s_{t})\in[0,1] that rises as the workflow is completed and falls on regressions.
sents.zh: PPRS 在每个回合 t 之后，都会将智能体的工作空间与来自我们潜在世界的已知正确中间状态进行比较，从而给出一个进展潜力 Φ(s_t) ∈ [0,1]；该值会随着工作流程的完成而上升，并在出现倒退时下降。

sents.en: Reward shaped by Φ \Phi gives within-group variance from the first turn, even when no rollout finishes.
sents.zh: 由 Φ 塑造的奖励即使在没有任何 rollout 完成的情况下，也能从第一个回合开始提供群体内部的方差。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 summarizes our approach and Tev ’s results, and Figure 2 ranks all models on the Terminal-Bench (TB) 4.0 “CM” subset by Pass@1. Using our latent-world-first synthesis approach, we introduce Tev-Gym , composed of 1,170 verified long-horizon task environments across 7 domains (software engineering, data engineering, AI/CS research, mathematics and operations research, security and forensics, infrastructure administration, and quantum computing). As illustrated in Table 1 , Tev-Gym ’s tasks take a frontier agent a median of 12.4 minutes per rollout, about 6 times longer than the most time-intensive prior corpus ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , and have the lowest pass rate, demonstrating our training data’s complexity and quality. Moreover, Tev-Gym can be scaled beyond a fixed collection by coding agents writing generators that produce new verified environments across seeds and scale tiers without further model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 总结了我们的方法以及 Tev 的结果，而图 2 则根据 Pass@1 指标对所有模型在 Terminal-Bench (TB) 4.0 “CM”子集上的表现进行了排名。 我们采用“潜在世界优先”的合成方法，提出了 Tev-Gym，它由 7 个领域（软件工程、数据工程、AI/CS 研究、数学与运筹学、安全与数字取证、基础设施管理和量子计算）中经过验证的 1,170 个长期任务环境组成。 如表 1 所示，Tev-Gym 的任务需要前沿智能体每次运行平均花费 12.4 分钟，比此前耗时最长的数据集（Yang et al., 2025a）长约 6 倍，且其通过率最低，这体现了我们训练数据的复杂性和高质量。 此外，Tev-Gym 可以通过编码智能体编写生成器来扩展其固定集合之外的规模，这些生成器能够在不同种子和规模层级中自动生成新的验证环境，而无需再次调用模型。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Tev -9B and Tev -27B, trained with PPRS on the unit tier and the full corpus of Tev-Gym , respectively. On ALE-CM , the computing-and-math split of Agents’ Last Exam ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , Tev -9B improves Pass@5 by 83 % 83\% over Qwen3.5-9B, while Tev -27B improves it by 65 % 65\% over Qwen3.8-27B to 0.28 0.28 , matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, Tev -27B generalizes to the TB 3.0 and 4.0 subsets ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Marten et al., 2026 ; Marten, 2026 ) , improving Pass@1 by 56 % 56\% and 150 % 150\% , respectively, and outperforming GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash. On the mid-horizon TB 2.1, Tev -9B improves zero-shot Pass@1 by 28 % 28\% , while Tev -27B reaches 0.794 0.794 Pass@1, matching Claude Opus 4.8-level performance. The recipe also transfers to a larger base: applying it to GLM-5.3-Flash yields Tev -320B, which raises Pass@1 on the TB 3.0 and 4.0 subsets by 35 % 35\% and 28 % 28\% and, on TB 4.0, trails only Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5, and GPT-5.6 (sol).
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 Tev -9B 和 Tev -27B，它们分别使用 PPRS 在单元层级和 Tev-Gym 完整语料库上进行训练。 在 ALE-CM（Agents’ Last Exam 的计算与数学分支，Sun et al., 2026）上，Tev -9B 的 Pass@5 指标比 Qwen3.5-9B 提升了 83%（83\%），而 Tev -27B 则比 Qwen3.8-27B 提升了 65%（65\%），达到 0.28（0.28），与 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Opus 5 的表现相当。 尽管仅使用与 ALE 相关的数据进行训练，Tev -27B 仍能泛化到 TB 3.0 和 4.0 子集（Merrill et al., 2026；Marten et al., 2026；Marten, 2026），其 Pass@1 指标分别提升了 56%（56\%）和 150%（150\%），并优于 GLM 5.2 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash。 在中期时间范围的 TB 2.1 上，Tev -9B 的零样本 Pass@1 提升了 28%（28\%），而 Tev -27B 的 Pass@1 达到了 0.794（0.794），与 Claude Opus 4.8 级别的性能相当。 该训练方法也适用于更大的基础模型：将其应用于 GLM-5.3-Flash 后，得到了 Tev -320B，它在 TB 3.0 和 4.0 子集上的 Pass@1 分别提升了 35%（35\%）和 28%（28\%），并且在 TB 4.0 上仅略逊于 Claude Opus 5、Claude Fable 5 和 GPT-5.6（sol）。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose latent-world-first synthesis , a pipeline that constructs long-horizon agentic tasks backward from a known-correct world, giving exact verification, a controllable difficulty ladder, and a progressive reward in the middle.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种“潜在世界优先”的合成方法，这是一种从已知正确的世界出发、逆向构建长期智能体任务的流程，能够提供精确验证、可控的难度阶梯以及中间阶段的渐进式奖励。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Tev-Gym , the first long-horizon agent training dataset with progressive rewards, composed of 1,170 verified long-horizon task environments across 7 domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 Tev-Gym——首个采用渐进式奖励的长期智能体训练数据集，该数据集包含来自 7 个领域的 1,170 个经过验证的长期任务环境。

paragraphs.en: We present Tev -27B , trained on Tev-Gym using PPRS, and demonstrate its superior performance on ALE-CM , the TB 3.0 and TB 4.0 subsets, and TB 2.1; the same recipe applied to GLM-5.3-Flash gives Tev -320B , which improves further.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 Tev -27B，该模型使用 PPRS 在 Tev-Gym 上进行训练，并在 ALE-CM、TB 3.0 和 TB 4.0 子集以及 TB 2.1 上展现了其卓越的性能；将相同的训练方法应用于 GLM-5.3-Flash，得到了 Tev -320B，其性能进一步提升。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 details the mechanisms of long-horizon environment reconstruction. This section defines how an environment is synthesized backward from a latent world (§ 2.1 ), and how coverage, difficulty, and correctness are enforced in Tev-Gym (§ 2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 详细说明了长期环境重建的机制。 本节定义了如何从潜在世界向后合成环境（§ 2.1），以及如何在 Tev-Gym 中确保覆盖性、难度和正确性（§ 2.2）。

sents.en: Figure 3 details the mechanisms of long-horizon environment reconstruction.
sents.zh: 图 3 详细说明了长期环境重建的机制。

sents.en: This section defines how an environment is synthesized backward from a latent world (§ 2.1 ), and how coverage, difficulty, and correctness are enforced in Tev-Gym (§ 2.2 ).
sents.zh: 本节定义了如何从潜在世界向后合成环境（§ 2.1），以及如何在 Tev-Gym 中确保覆盖性、难度和正确性（§ 2.2）。

paragraphs.en: Stage 0: task sources. Our training data targets ALE-CM , whose coverage we group into seven major domains. Within each domain, we randomly sample specifications and author our own generator around each one. For details, please refer to Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 0：任务来源。 我们的训练数据以 ALE-CM 为目标，并将其覆盖范围划分为七个主要领域。 在每个领域中，我们会随机抽取规范，并围绕每个规范构建我们自己的生成器。 更多细节请参阅附录 A.1。

sents.en: Stage 0: task sources.
sents.zh: 阶段 0：任务来源。

sents.en: Our training data targets ALE-CM , whose coverage we group into seven major domains.
sents.zh: 我们的训练数据以 ALE-CM 为目标，并将其覆盖范围划分为七个主要领域。

sents.en: Within each domain, we randomly sample specifications and author our own generator around each one.
sents.zh: 在每个领域中，我们会随机抽取规范，并围绕每个规范构建我们自己的生成器。

sents.en: For details, please refer to Appendix A.1 .
sents.zh: 更多细节请参阅附录 A.1。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: world construction. Each generator is a seeded program. Given a seed and a scale tier, it procedurally generates the latent world W W , the complete, correct state of the domain (e.g., a retail warehouse’s customers, products, and transactions, or a distributed checkpoint’s tensor shards and topology), and we validate W W against the environment’s invariants (unique identities, valid joins, finite measures). The same step draws a seed-derived defect plan : exactly which records, shards, or fields of W W will later be corrupted, and by which declared operator.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：世界构建。 每个生成器都是一个带有种子的程序。 给定一个种子和一个规模层级，它会程序化地生成潜在世界 W W，即该领域的完整、正确状态（例如，零售仓库的客户、产品和交易，或分布式检查点的张量分片和拓扑结构），并且我们会根据环境的不变量（唯一标识、有效连接、有限度量）来验证 W W。 同一步骤还会生成一个源自种子的缺陷计划：明确哪些记录、分片或 W W 的字段将在后续被损坏，以及由哪个声明的操作符执行该损坏。

sents.en: Stage 1: world construction.
sents.zh: 阶段 1：世界构建。

sents.en: Each generator is a seeded program.
sents.zh: 每个生成器都是一个带有种子的程序。

sents.en: Given a seed and a scale tier, it procedurally generates the latent world W W , the complete, correct state of the domain (e.g., a retail warehouse’s customers, products, and transactions, or a distributed checkpoint’s tensor shards and topology), and we validate W W against the environment’s invariants (unique identities, valid joins, finite measures).
sents.zh: 给定一个种子和一个规模层级，它会程序化地生成潜在世界 W W，即该领域的完整、正确状态（例如，零售仓库的客户、产品和交易，或分布式检查点的张量分片和拓扑结构），并且我们会根据环境的不变量（唯一标识、有效连接、有限度量）来验证 W W。

sents.en: The same step draws a seed-derived defect plan : exactly which records, shards, or fields of W W will later be corrupted, and by which declared operator.
sents.zh: 同一步骤还会生成一个源自种子的缺陷计划：明确哪些记录、分片或 W W 的字段将在后续被损坏，以及由哪个声明的操作符执行该损坏。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2: workflow graph. We compile the environment’s workflow into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of stages with explicit dependencies, permitted parallelism, and per-stage semantic-work estimates (e.g., profile-sources → \rightarrow reconcile-facts / normalize-dimensions → \rightarrow load-facts → \rightarrow aggregate-validate → \rightarrow package-sidecars ). The DAG is built by code from the scale of W W , with no model in the loop. Its critical path, the longest chain of dependent stages, defines the task’s horizon, and its stages form the skeleton of the progress potential in § 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2：工作流图。 我们将环境的工作流编译为一个有向无环图（DAG），其中包含各阶段的明确依赖关系、允许的并行性，以及每个阶段的语义工作量估计值（例如：profile-sources → \rightarrow reconcile-facts / normalize-dimensions → \rightarrow load-facts → \rightarrow aggregate-validate → \rightarrow package-sidecars）。 该 DAG 由代码构建，其规模与 W W 相当，且循环中不包含任何模型。 其关键路径（即依赖阶段构成的最长链）决定了任务的时限，而其中的各阶段则构成了 § 3 中进展潜力的框架。

sents.en: Stage 2: workflow graph.
sents.zh: 阶段 2：工作流图。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3: artifact rendering. We project W W onto the environment’s declared public interface, materializing the clean input files in their target wire formats: CSV and TSV partitions, JSON records, SQLite databases, safetensors shards, stripped binaries, or infrastructure manifests. Rendering is a pure function of W W , and before proceeding we assert that it round-trips, i.e., that W W is recovered exactly from the rendered files. Together with the invertible corruption of Stage 4, this makes the agent’s workspace s 0 s_{0} fully determine W W , so the correct answer is computable from what the agent actually sees, and the ground truth is correct by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 3：产物渲染。 我们将 W W 投影到环境声明的公共接口上，将干净的输入文件具体化为其目标线格式：CSV 和 TSV 分区、JSON 记录、SQLite 数据库、safetensors 分片、剥离后的二进制文件或基础设施清单。 渲染是 W W 的一个纯函数，在继续之前，我们断言其具备往返一致性，即 W W 可以从渲染后的文件中被精确恢复。 结合阶段 4 的可逆损坏处理，这使得智能体的工作空间 s 0 s_{0} 能够完全确定 W W ，因此正确答案可以从智能体实际看到的内容中计算得出，而基准答案在构造上就是正确的。

paragraphs.en: Stage 4: controlled corruption. We apply the Stage-1 defect plan to the rendered files, injecting schema drift, duplicate and missing records, categorical drift, scrambled shard indices, stale caches, and the like (Figure 3 shows the three operators of one environment). The corrupted tree s 0 s_{0} is the task the agent receives, and the untouched world W W is the ground truth. Because rendering round-trips and corruption is declared and invertible, s 0 s_{0} fully determines W W : the correct solution is computable from what the agent sees and is known exactly without running a solver. paragraphs.en: Stages 5 and 6: public specification and hidden suite. We emit the public contract, the task prompt x x (input roles, required output artifacts and their schemas, ordered requirements, authority-precedence rules, and the permitted toolchain), which is the only description the agent sees. Outside the agent’s view, we seal a hidden suite used at verification time: metamorphic transforms, which are semantics-preserving rewrites that must not change the grade, and stale-output counterfactuals, which are plausible-but-wrong states that must fail.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5 阶段和第 6 阶段：公开规范与隐藏套件。 我们发布公开合同，即任务提示 x x（输入角色、所需的输出产物及其模式、有序要求、权限优先级规则以及允许使用的工具链），这是智能体唯一能看到的描述。 在智能体视角之外，我们封装了一个用于验证时的隐藏套件：形态变换（语义保持的重写，不得改变等级）和旧输出反事实（合理但错误的状态，必须失败）。

paragraphs.en: Generalization of latent-world-first synthesis. We focus on the ALE-CM domains due to resource constraints, but the approach applies to other ALE domains. Appendix A.10 walks through three environments built by the pipeline: a multimodal AWS cost-optimization task with its billing-dashboard screenshot rendered from our latent world (cloud operations), closed-loop building control of an EnergyPlus model (engineering), and financial-statement reconstruction from SEC-style filings (finance).
paragraphs.zh: 潜在世界优先合成的泛化。 由于资源限制，我们专注于 ALE-CM 领域，但该方法也适用于其他 ALE 领域。 附录 A.10 详细说明了由该流程构建的三个环境：一个多模态的 AWS 成本优化任务（其计费仪表板截图由我们的潜在世界（云操作）渲染生成）、EnergyPlus 模型的闭环建筑控制（工程领域），以及基于 SEC 风格文件的财务报表重建（金融领域）。

paragraphs.en: Diversity. Every environment is labeled on 19 coverage axes (Appendix A.3 ), including subdomain, scale, the four horizon axes, workflow stage, tool capability, artifact role, relation type, and corruption class. The axes that matter for training are behavioral: changing their value changes what the agent must repair (corruption class), how (workflow stage, tool capability), and through which files (artifact role, relation type). For more details, please see our Appendix A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 多样性。 每个环境都在 19 个覆盖轴（附录 A.3）上进行标注，包括子领域、规模、四个时间范围轴、工作流程阶段、工具能力、产物角色、关系类型和损坏类别。 对训练而言，重要的轴是行为相关的：改变这些轴的值会改变智能体必须修复的内容（损坏类别）、修复方式（工作流程阶段、工具能力）以及通过哪些文件进行修复（产物角色、关系类型）。 更多详情请参见我们的附录 A.3。

paragraphs.en: Controllable difficulty. Two controls change a task’s difficulty. The scale tier (by default unit , small , or full ) grows W W (Appendix A.4 ) and lengthens the operational horizon: how much must be read, joined, and written. The workflow DAG of Stage 2, together with the number of corruption classes in the defect plan, fixes the dependency depth: how many stages must be completed, and in which order, before any output can be right. Appendix A.5 states how we measure horizon and difficulty and reports base-model and frontier solve rates.
paragraphs.zh: 可控难度。 两个控制项可以改变任务的难度。 规模层级（默认为单位、小型或完整）会扩大 W W（附录 A.4），并延长操作时间范围：即需要阅读、连接和写入的内容量。 第 2 阶段的流程 DAG，连同缺陷计划中的错误类型数量，决定了依赖深度：在获得任何正确输出之前，必须按特定顺序完成多少个阶段。 附录 A.5 说明了如何衡量时间范围和难度，并报告了基础模型和前沿模型的解决速率。

paragraphs.en: Qualification gates and cleanliness. A synthesized environment is admitted only if it passes all eight benchmark-independent gates, checked automatically at generation time and each matched to a named failure class (Table 7 ). Three of them back the progress potential of § 3.2 : all 14 gaming probes must score 0 0 ( exploit resistance ), the potential must lie strictly between 0 0 and 1 1 on partially correct states and increase monotonically to 1 1 along the reference trajectory ( progress validity ), and the progress scorer, strict verifier, and reference solvers must have disjoint code closures ( role independence ). Appendix A.6 states every gate formally, together with the verifier-independent solver audit, and Appendix A.9 describes the structural decontamination check.
paragraphs.zh: 资格关卡与纯净性。 一个合成环境只有在通过全部八个与基准无关的关卡时才能被接纳；这些关卡在生成时自动检查，且每个关卡都与一个命名的失败类别相匹配（表 7）。 其中三项支持了 § 3.2 中的进展潜力：所有 14 个游戏探针的得分必须为 0 0（抗利用性），在部分正确的状态下，该潜力必须严格位于 0 0 和 1 1 之间，并沿参考轨迹单调增至 1 1（进展有效性）；此外，进展评分器、严格验证器和参考求解器的代码闭包必须互不重叠（角色独立性）。 附录 A.6 正式陈述了每个关卡，并附带了与验证器无关的求解器审计；附录 A.9 则描述了结构净化检查。

paragraphs.en: The latent world that grades task completion also grades its middle. This section turns it into a training signal: we quantify why terminal-only reward starves group-relative RL (§ 3.1 ), define the progress potential every Tev-Gym environment provides (§ 3.2 ), and detail the shaped reward (§ 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估任务完成度的潜在世界也同时评估其过程。 本节将其转化为训练信号：我们量化为何仅依赖最终奖励会抑制群体相对强化学习（§ 3.1），定义每个 Tev-Gym 环境提供的进展潜力（§ 3.2），并详细说明塑造后的奖励机制（§ 3.3）。

paragraphs.en: Preventing reward hacking. Three properties make Φ \Phi a usable training signal, each enforced by a qualification gate (§ 2.2 ): it is anchored (exploit resistance), with the untouched public tree and every gaming probe scoring Φ = 0 \Phi=0 and Φ = 1 \Phi=1 exactly when the strict verifier accepts the workspace; monotone (progress validity), rising as nodes are completed and falling when completed work is destroyed; and independent (role independence), computed by a scorer whose code closure is disjoint from those of the verifier and the reference solvers, so a defect in one grader is not inherited by the other; none of this grading code is shipped in the public tree.
paragraphs.zh: 防止奖励欺骗。 三个特性使 Φ \Phi 成为一个可用的训练信号，每个特性都由一个资格门（§ 2.2）强制执行：它具有锚定性（抗利用性），即未修改的公共树和所有游戏探测在严格验证器接受工作区时恰好得到 Φ = 0 \Phi=0 和 Φ = 1 \Phi=1；具有单调性（进展有效性），即随着节点完成而上升，当已完成的工作被破坏时下降；并且具有独立性（角色独立性），即由一个评分器计算，其代码闭包与验证器和参考求解器的代码闭包不相交，因此一个评分器中的缺陷不会传递到另一个；这些评分代码中没有任何一部分包含在公共树中。

paragraphs.en: Substituting Eq. ( 4 ) into Eq. ( 2 ) shows why this repairs the starvation of GRPO. A group in which no rollout passes now has rewards R i = λ ​ Φ ​ ( s T ( i ) ) R_{i}=\lambda\Phi(s_{T}^{(i)}) , where s T ( i ) s_{T}^{(i)} is the final workspace of τ i \tau_{i} . These differ whenever the rollouts progressed to different depths, so the group’s advantages are non-zero and rank the rollouts by progress; Figure 4 shows one such group, and Appendix B the 24 groups we probed.
paragraphs.zh: 将方程 (4) 代入方程 (2)，可以说明为何这种方法能够解决 GRPO 中的“饥饿”问题。现在，一个没有 rollout 通过的组别将获得奖励 R_i = λ Φ(s_T^{(i)})，其中 s_T^{(i)} 是 τ_i 的最终工作区。只要各 rollout 推进到了不同的深度，这些奖励就会有所不同，因此该组的优势值非零，并能根据 rollout 的进展对其进行排序；图 4 展示了这样一个组别，附录 B 则列出了我们探究的 24 个组别。

paragraphs.en: Our main experiments ask three questions. Does RL on Tev-Gym improve open models on the long-horizon tasks it was built for, do the gains generalize to tasks of even longer horizon, and does the model keep its general coding competence on a standard mid-horizon benchmark (§ 4.2 )? Finally, § 4.3 ablates our latent-world-first data and the dense reward approaches, separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要实验提出了三个问题。 RL 在 Tev-Gym 上是否提升了开放模型在其设计初衷的长期任务上的表现？这些改进能否推广到时间跨度更长的任务中？以及该模型在标准的中期任务基准测试（§ 4.2）中是否仍能保持其通用编码能力？ 最后，§ 4.3 分别对我们的潜在世界优先数据方法和密集奖励方法进行了消融分析。

paragraphs.en: Training. We train Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B using DPPO ( Qi et al., 2026 ) with the reward in our Eq. ( 4 ), scaling the training data together with the model: the 9B model trains on a 264-task subset of Tev-Gym from the unit difficulty tier, which is better suited for learning at this model scale, while the 27B model trains on the full corpus. We choose G = 24 G{=}24 rollouts for each of 8 tasks per step, a response budget of 65,536 tokens per rollout (16,384 per turn), and at most 64 tool calls, in a sandbox that exposes a single bash tool. Our 27B model is trained on 4 nodes of B200 GPUs or 8 nodes of A100 GPUs for about 4 days. For more details, refer to Appendix C . To test whether the recipe transfers to a larger base model, we also train GLM-5.3-Flash with the same recipe, obtaining Tev -320B, which we evaluate on the TB 3.0 and 4.0 subsets.
paragraphs.zh: 训练。我们使用 DPPO（Qi et al., 2026）对我们的公式 (4) 中的奖励函数进行训练，以训练 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.8-27B，并将训练数据与模型一同进行缩放：9B 模型在 Tev-Gym 中单位难度层级的 264 个任务子集上进行训练，这更适合该模型规模的學習；而 27B 模型则在完整语料库上进行训练。我们为每一步的 8 个任务选择 G = 24 次 rollout，每次 rollout 的响应预算为 65,536 个 token（每回合 16,384 个），最多允许 64 次工具调用，并在仅提供一个 bash 工具的沙盒环境中执行。我们的 27B 模型在 4 台 B200 GPU 节点或 8 台 A100 GPU 节点上训练了约 4 天。更多细节请参见附录 C。为了测试该训练方案能否迁移到更大的基础模型，我们还使用相同的方案训练了 GLM-5.3-Flash，得到了 Tev-320B，并在 TB 3.0 和 4.0 子集上对其进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation. Long-horizon agent evaluation tasks are scarce and costly, with each requiring up to eight hours to evaluate. Our in-domain suite, ALE-CM , is the computing-and-math split of Agents’ Last Exam ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , listed in Appendix C.2 (Table 12 ). On TB 3.0 and 4.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Marten et al., 2026 ; Marten, 2026 ) we evaluate the “CM” subsets (22 and 18 tasks). To form them we asked Claude to judge, for every TB 3.0 task, whether it belongs to the computing-and-math domain, even if only slightly; the selection and the full task lists are given in Appendix C.2 (Table 13 ). We compare leaderboard model performance on the full ALE, TB 3.0, and TB 4.0 benchmarks with performance on our corresponding subsets. The results show that our splits are representative of full-set performance, with Pearson correlations of r = 0.96 r=0.96 for TB 3.0 P@1 and r = 0.97 r=0.97 for TB 4.0 P@1 (Appendix C.2 ; Tables 14 , 15 , and 16 ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估。 长期智能体评估任务稀缺且成本高昂，每个任务的评估时间最多需要八小时。 我们的领域内测试集 ALE-CM 是“智能体最终考试”（Sun et al., 2026）的计算与数学分支，列于附录 C.2（表 12）。 在 TB 3.0 和 4.0（Merrill et al., 2026；Marten et al., 2026；Marten, 2026）上，我们评估了“CM”子集（分别包含 22 个和 18 个任务）。 为了构建这些子集，我们要求 Claude 对 TB 3.0 中的每个任务进行判断，确定其是否属于计算与数学领域，即使仅属于该领域的一小部分；具体的选择标准和完整任务列表见附录 C.2（表 13）。 我们将排行榜模型在完整 ALE、TB 3.0 和 TB 4.0 基准测试上的表现，与我们对应的子集上的表现进行比较。 结果表明，我们的子集划分能够代表完整数据集的表现：TB 3.0 的 P@1 得分与完整数据集的 Pearson 相关系数为 r = 0.96，TB 4.0 的 P@1 得分相关系数为 r = 0.97（附录 C.2；表 14、15 和 16）。

paragraphs.en: Train/eval decontamination. We measure lexical leakage per evaluation set: no environment of Tev-Gym shares a 13-gram or an 8-gram with any task of ALE-CM , TB 3.0, TB 4.0 or TB 2.1, and the median nearest-neighbor prompt Jaccard of the evaluation tasks to the dataset is 0.13 0.13 on TB 3.0/4.0 and 0.22 0.22 on ALE-CM , against 0.24 0.24 – 0.25 0.25 and 0.28 0.28 for tasks of the same benchmark compared with one another. For more details, refer to Appendix A.9 , Table 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 训练/评估去污染。 我们按每个评估集测量词汇泄露情况：Tev-Gym 的任何环境都没有与 ALE-CM、TB 3.0、TB 4.0 或 TB 2.1 中的任何任务共享 13-gram 或 8-gram，且评估任务与数据集之间的最近邻提示 Jaccard 指数中位数为 0.13（TB 3.0/4.0）和 0.22（ALE-CM），而同一基准测试中的不同任务之间该指数为 0.24–0.25 和 0.28。 更多细节请参见附录 A.9 和表 10。

paragraphs.en: Results on long-horizon tasks. As shown in Table 2 , Tev -9B improves mean S@1 by 16% and nearly doubles its best-of-5 solve rate over Qwen3.5-9B, while Tev -27B produces 33 % 33\% more full solutions than Qwen3.8-27B. Trained on the full corpus rather than the unit tier, Tev -27B shows larger absolute gains than Tev -9B on every metric and surpasses Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B under the same harness on P@1. Although Claude Fable 5 reaches only 0.33 0.33 P@5, training raises the 27B model from 0.17 0.17 to 0.28 0.28 , reaching 85 % 85\% of the frontier score and closing more than two-thirds of the original gap.
paragraphs.zh: 长期任务上的结果。 如表 2 所示，Tev-9B 将平均 S@1 提升了 16%，其最佳 5 次尝试的解决率几乎是 Qwen3.5-9B 的两倍；而 Tev-27B 产生的完整解决方案比 Qwen3.8-27B 多 33%（33\%）。 Tev-27B 是在完整语料库而非单元层级上训练的，它在所有指标上的绝对提升都大于 Tev-9B，并且在 P@1 上于相同测试框架下超越了 Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B。 尽管 Claude Fable 5 的 P@5 仅达到 0.33（0.33），但训练使 27B 模型从 0.17（0.17）提升至 0.28（0.28），达到了前沿分数的 85%（85\%），并缩小了超过三分之二的原始差距。

paragraphs.en: Results on longer-horizon tasks. The TB 3.0 and 4.0 “CM” subsets are even more challenging, with each task requiring eight hours of expert work. Our 27B base model fully solves only 9 % 9\% and 4 % 4\% of attempted tasks, respectively. As shown in Table 3 , Tev -27B raises P@1 from 0.04 0.04 to 0.10 0.10 ( 2.5 × 2.5\times ) on TB 4.0 and from 0.09 0.09 to 0.14 0.14 ( + 56 % +56\% ) on TB 3.0. Notably, Tev -27B surpasses GLM 5.2, the strongest open-source model on the leaderboard. Compared with frontier models, however, a substantial gap remains. Claude Opus 5, the strongest agent on both suites, achieves P@1 scores of 0.53 0.53 on TB 3.0 and 0.52 0.52 on TB 4.0, suggesting that stronger open-source base models are needed to fully benefit from our high-quality but challenging Tev-Gym .

paragraphs.en: Scaling the base model. Consistent with this, the recipe carries over to a stronger base. Applying it to GLM-5.3-Flash yields Tev -320B, whose P@1 rises from 0.20 0.20 to 0.27 0.27 on TB 3.0 and from 0.29 0.29 to 0.37 0.37 on TB 4.0, with gains in every category on both suites and the largest on TB 3.0 security ( 0.22 0.22 to 0.45 0.45 ). paragraphs.en: Results on middle-horizon tasks. We next evaluate our model on TB 2.1 (Table 4 ), a standard mid-horizon terminal benchmark. Despite zero data targeting TB 2.1, our model shows strong zero-shot performance. Tev -9B significantly outperforms its base after training, raising P@1 by 28 % 28\% and P@5 by 19 % 19\% , showing that training on long-horizon tasks also improves performance on standard mid-horizon work. Our 27B model achieves P@1 0.794 0.794 and P@5 0.884 0.884 , a smaller but consistent gain over its base and on par with Claude Opus 4.8, though still behind Claude Fable 5 and GPT-6 Astra.
paragraphs.zh: 中短期任务上的结果。 接下来，我们在 TB 2.1（表 4）上评估了我们的模型，这是一个标准的中短期终端基准测试。 尽管没有针对 TB 2.1 的零样本数据，我们的模型仍表现出强大的零样本性能。 Tev -9B 在训练后显著优于其基础模型，将 P@1 提升了 28%（28\%），P@5 提升了 19%（19\%），这表明对长期任务的训练也能提升标准中短期任务的性能。 我们的 27B 模型实现了 P@1 0.794（0.794）和 P@5 0.884（0.884），虽然提升幅度较小，但相较于其基础模型表现稳定，并与 Claude Opus 4.8 相当，尽管仍落后于 Claude Fable 5 和 GPT-6 Astra。

Figure 5 traces the key decision points of four rollouts on the k8s_payment_api_root_cause_analysis task: every agent finds the same root causes, but Tev -27B and Claude Fable 5 ground the liveness-probe cause in the measurement that explains it and judge rollback safe, whereas the base model and GPT-6 Astra cite only the symptoms and decline rollback, forfeiting the decisive grader component. paragraphs.en: Due to resource constraints, we conduct the ablation study in the 9B setting of § 4.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 由于资源限制，我们在 § 4.1 的 9B 设置中进行消融研究。

paragraphs.en: Ablation on data curation methods. Our pipeline differs from standard LLM-synthesized corpora in two key ways: tasks are derived from a preexisting latent world and its code-compiled workflow DAG, and verifiers evaluate against this hidden ground truth rather than only agent-visible files. Table 5 shows which components each ablation retains, with GPT-5.6 (sol, xhigh) replacing the others. Public-view verifier ablates only access to hidden ground truth by asking the model to write a verifier from the agent’s view. Prompt-first , a standard self-instruct baseline, instead replaces the entire construction pipeline by generating each prompt before its inputs, verifier, and solution, leaving no latent world or DAG. The public-view variant causes 88% of sampled groups to be discarded during training. Because both variants use terminal rewards, we compare them with the Sparse row: neither improves over the base model in S@1 ( 0.24 0.24 and 0.23 0.23 vs. 0.25 0.25 ), whereas our full method leads them by 0.05 0.05 – 0.06 0.06 in S@1 and 0.05 0.05 in P@5.
paragraphs.zh: 数据整理方法的消融分析。 我们的流程与标准 LLM 合成语料库在两个关键方面有所不同：任务源自一个预先存在的潜在世界及其代码编译的工作流 DAG，而验证器则是基于这一隐藏的真实情况进行评估，而非仅依据智能体可见的文件。 表 5 展示了每次消融保留了哪些组件，其中 GPT-5.6（sol, xhigh）替代了其他组件。 公开视角的验证器仅通过要求模型从智能体的视角编写验证器，从而限制了对隐藏真实情况的访问。 Prompt-first，一种标准的自我指导基线方法，则通过在每个提示词生成其输入、验证器和解决方案之前生成该提示词，来完全替换整个构建流程，因此不存在潜在世界或 DAG。 公开视角的变体导致在训练过程中 88% 的采样组被丢弃。 由于两种变体都使用了终端奖励，我们将其与 Sparse 行进行比较：两者在 S@1 上均未优于基础模型（0.24 0.24 和 0.23 0.23 对比 0.25 0.25），而我们的完整方法在 S@1 上领先 0.05 0.05 – 0.06 0.06，在 P@5 上领先 0.05 0.05。

paragraphs.en: Ablation on dense reward. Holding Tev-Gym fixed, we compare our PPRS, which uses return-to-go G t G_{t} with γ = 1 \gamma=1 and normalizes advantages by turn index, against terminal-only sparse reward, PPRS with per-rollout normalization ( pooled norm. ), and direct additive reward using Φ ⁡ ( s t ) \Phi(s_{t}) with γ = 0 \gamma=0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Our method provides the best balance of performance and training efficiency, improving S@1 by 0.04 0.04 over sparse reward. Turn-index normalization preserves credit for later turns by avoiding comparison of their smaller returns against the whole-rollout mean, while γ = 1 \gamma=1 propagates progress back to earlier actions. In contrast, direct additive reward repeatedly rewards high-potential states without propagating credit, leading to more rollouts exhausting the context window before submission and producing longer trajectories. The advantage over sparse reward widens further at 27B, where shaped reward trains to completion but terminal-only reward produces almost entirely zero-advantage groups and fails to complete a single optimizer step.
paragraphs.zh: 密集奖励的消融研究。 在保持 Tev-Gym 不变的情况下，我们将使用“返回至目标”G t G_{t}（其中 γ = 1 \gamma=1）并通过回合索引对优势值进行归一化的 PPRS，与仅使用终端稀疏奖励的 PPRS、每次展开归一化的 PPRS（池化归一化），以及使用 Φ⁡(s_t) \Phi(s_{t}) 且 γ = 0 \gamma=0 的直接累加奖励方法（Yuan et al., 2026）进行了比较。 我们的方法在性能与训练效率之间实现了最佳平衡，相比稀疏奖励方法，S@1 提升了 0.04。 回合索引归一化通过避免将后续回合较小的回报值与整个展开过程的均值进行比较，从而保留了后续回合的功劳；而 γ = 1 \gamma=1 则能将进展回溯至更早的动作。 相比之下，直接累加奖励会反复奖励高潜力状态，却无法传递功劳，导致更多展开在提交前耗尽上下文窗口，并生成更长的轨迹。 在 27B 模型上，与稀疏奖励相比的优势进一步扩大：经过形状设计的奖励方法能够完成训练，而仅使用终端奖励的方法则几乎完全产生零优势组，甚至无法完成单个优化器步骤。

sents.zh: 密集奖励的消融研究。

sents.en: Holding Tev-Gym fixed, we compare our PPRS, which uses return-to-go G t G_{t} with γ = 1 \gamma=1 and normalizes advantages by turn index, against terminal-only sparse reward, PPRS with per-rollout normalization ( pooled norm. ), and direct additive reward using Φ ⁡ ( s t ) \Phi(s_{t}) with γ = 0 \gamma=0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Synthetic corpora for coding and terminal agents. Recent corpora typically mine repositories for issues and tests or use language models to generate tasks such as bug-injected repositories and reconstructed terminal sessions ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Ivison et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . Other work scales executable tool-use environments and their success conditions ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) , although scaling helps only when difficulty is controlled ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) . In contrast, our environments contain long, multi-stage workflows across mathematics and science, machine learning, coding, and systems; are instantiated by seeded generator code rather than directly authored by a language model; and provide a dense progress signal for every task.
paragraphs.zh: 用于编码和终端智能体的合成语料库。 近期的语料库通常从代码仓库中挖掘问题与测试用例，或使用语言模型生成任务，例如注入错误的代码仓库和重构后的终端会话（Jimenez 等，2024；Yang 等，2025a；Ivison 等，2026；Lin 等，2026）。 其他研究则扩展了可执行工具使用环境及其成功条件（Cai 等，2025；Fang 等，2025），但只有在难度受控的情况下，这种扩展才有意义（Zhu 等，2026b）。 相比之下，我们的环境包含跨数学与科学、机器学习、编码和系统领域的长流程多阶段工作流；由预置的生成器代码实例化，而非直接由语言模型编写；并为每个任务提供密集的前进信号。

paragraphs.en: Backward construction. Deriving a task from a known solution is an established family: denoising, controlled error injection, code mutation, environment rewinding, instruction back-translation, and procedural puzzle generation all corrupt or invert a single artifact whose ground truth is already known ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Arocena et al., 2015 ; Tran et al., 2013 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Hariharan et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Stojanovski et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . We instead corrupt a rendering of an entire latent world, so the task, verifier, and progress signal are all functions of that one world rather than separately generated factors that can drift apart ( Zeng et al., 2026a ; Ivanov and Rana, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 逆向构建。 从已知解中推导出任务是一种成熟的方法：去噪、受控错误注入、代码变异、环境回滚、指令反向翻译以及程序化谜题生成，这些方法都会破坏或反转一个其真实答案已知的单一产物（Lewis et al., 2020 ; Arocena et al., 2015 ; Tran et al., 2013 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Hariharan et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Stojanovski et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025）。 我们则选择破坏整个潜在世界的渲染结果，因此任务、验证器和进度信号都是该单一世界的函数，而非可能相互偏离的独立生成因素（Zeng et al., 2026a ; Ivanov and Rana, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Sparse reward and dense signal in agentic RL. Existing methods avoid uninformative rollout groups by filtering identical rewards, selecting tasks near the policy’s current ability, or adding expert prefixes ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Florensa et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) . Other approaches provide denser feedback through learned judges ( Cui et al., 2025 ; Choudhury, 2025 ) or proxy signals such as test-pass rates ( Du et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , but these require additional models or capture only terminal outcomes. Our potential Φ \Phi instead measures exact progress and regression against the latent world at every workflow stage, without requiring a critic or language-model judge. For full related work, please refer to Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体强化学习中的稀疏奖励与密集信号。 现有方法通过过滤相同奖励、选择与策略当前能力相近的任务，或添加专家前缀（Yu et al., 2025; Florensa et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2025c），来避免无信息价值的展开组。 其他方法则通过学习到的评判者（Cui et al., 2025; Choudhury, 2025）或代理信号（如测试通过率，Du et al., 2025; Shen et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2026）提供更密集的反馈，但这些方法需要额外模型，或仅能捕捉最终结果。 我们的潜在函数 Φ \Phi 则直接衡量在每个工作流程阶段相对于潜在世界的精确进展与退步，且无需评判者或语言模型评判者。 关于相关工作的完整讨论，请参阅附录 D。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a latent-world-first approach for scaling verifiable long-horizon agent training. Each task is built backward from a known-correct latent world, which is rendered into interrelated files, modified through controlled corruptions, and reused for exact verification and dense progress rewards. We instantiate this approach in Tev-Gym , a collection of 1,170 verified environments across seven domains, and show that training improves both 9B and 27B open models on ALE-CM, with gains transferring to Terminal-Bench tasks of different horizons and to a 320B base model. One limitation of our current study is its focus on synthetic terminal environments, and the hardest benchmarks still show a gap between our models and leading frontier agents. Supporting new workflows also requires authoring and validating additional environment components. Future work could simplify this process, expand domain coverage, and combine the resulting data with stronger open models, making more professional workflows available for reproducible RL without human step labels or language-model judges.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种以潜在世界为先的方法，用于扩展可验证的长期智能体训练。 每个任务都从已知正确的潜在世界开始反向构建：该世界被渲染为相互关联的文件，通过受控的破坏进行修改，并用于精确验证和提供密集进展奖励。 我们在 Tev-Gym 中实现了这一方法——这是一个包含七个领域共 1,170 个已验证环境的集合。实验表明，该方法提升了 ALE-CM 上 9B 和 27B 开放模型的性能，且改进效果可迁移至不同时间跨度的 Terminal-Bench 任务以及一个 320B 的基础模型。 当前研究的一个局限性是，其重点放在了合成终端环境上，而最难的基准测试中，我们的模型与顶尖前沿智能体之间仍存在差距。 支持新的工作流程还需要编写并验证额外的环境组件。 未来的工作可以简化这一流程、扩大领域覆盖范围，并将生成的数据与更强大的开放模型结合，从而无需人工步骤标签或语言模型判官，即可实现更具专业性的可复现强化学习工作流程。

paragraphs.en: We used generative AI tools for the following tasks that require disclosure. Generating synthetic data and implementing methods: coding agents helped author the generators of Tev-Gym , that is, the environment specifications and their reference solvers, strict verifiers, and progress scorers (§ 2 ; Appendix A.2 ). Once authored, a generator is a deterministic seeded program, so no language model participates when an environment is generated, verified, or rewarded; every generator passed the qualification gates of Appendix A.6 , and the authors reviewed each specification. Qualitative data analysis: Claude helped judge which TB 3.0 and 4.0 tasks relate to the computing-and-math domain of our training data, which defines our “CM” evaluation subsets; Appendix C.2 gives the procedure and the resulting task lists, and Appendix C.2 checks that the subsets track full-benchmark performance. Coding assistants also helped write evaluation and analysis scripts. Separately, language models appear in our experiments as objects of study rather than as aids to the authors: GPT-5.6 (sol) builds the two data-ablation baselines (§ 4.3 ), Gemini 3.6 Flash is the fixed evaluator of the corpus difficulty comparison (Appendix A.8 ), and frontier models are evaluated as baselines. No generative model grades any task or produces any training reward. Among tasks with recommended disclosure, we used generative AI tools to search and summarize related literature and to draft and edit parts of the text. Translation, surveys, interviews, and transcription are not applicable to this work. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work, and all claims, numbers, and citations were checked by the authors. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, and artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

paragraphs.en: Tev-Gym is fully synthetic: every environment is generated procedurally from a seed, contains no data collected from people, and involves no human subjects, so the corpus encodes no private records or proprietary code. Task specifications are drawn from public benchmarks and reference material (Appendix A.1 ), but every artifact an agent sees is generated by the environment itself, and third-party benchmarks and corpora used for evaluation and comparison are used under their published licenses (Appendix A.8 ). The environments simulate professional workflows such as data reconciliation, checkpoint consolidation, systems administration, and the analysis of synthetic binaries and packet captures in the style of capture-the-flag exercises. Each declares its toolchain in its public contract, the agent’s workspace is seeded only with its public tree, and no task targets real software, systems, or people. Improving open-weight agents on long-horizon terminal tasks carries the general dual-use considerations of more capable coding agents; our security-flavored tasks are analysis and forensics exercises over synthetic artifacts, the same class of task already present in public terminal-agent benchmarks. Because part of the training mix is built against the interfaces of ALE-CM , we measure train/evaluation overlap for every evaluation set and report it with its calibration (§ 4.1 ; Appendix A.9 ). Frontier baselines run in their native agent harnesses, the setting most favorable to them (Appendix C.2 ), and we discuss the limitations of our results in § 6 .
paragraphs.zh: Tev-Gym 完全由合成数据构成：每个环境都通过种子值进行程序化生成，不包含从人类那里收集的任何数据，也不涉及任何人类受试者，因此其语料库中不存在任何私人记录或专有代码。 任务规范源自公开基准和参考材料（附录 A.1），但智能体所见的每一个产物均由环境本身生成；用于评估和比较的第三方基准与语料库均依据其已发布的许可协议使用（附录 A.8）。 这些环境模拟了专业工作流程，例如数据核对、检查点整合、系统管理，以及以“夺旗”练习风格对合成二进制文件和数据包捕获进行分析。 每个环境都在其公开合同中声明了自己的工具链，智能体的工作区仅通过其公开树初始化，且没有任何任务针对真实的软件、系统或人类。 提升开放权重智能体在长期终端任务上的表现，会涉及更强大编码智能体所具有的一般性双重用途问题；我们设计的带有安全属性的任务，是对合成产物进行的分析与数字取证练习，这类任务在公开的终端智能体基准中已存在。 由于训练数据的一部分是基于 ALE-CM 的接口构建的，因此我们对每个评估集都测量了训练与评估之间的重叠度，并在 §4.1 和附录 A.9 中报告了校准结果。 Frontier 基线模型在其原生智能体运行框架中执行（这是对其最有利的环境，见附录 C.2），我们在 §6 中讨论了研究结果的局限性。

paragraphs.en: We have written the paper and appendix so that every result can be reproduced from them. Data. Every environment of Tev-Gym is a deterministic, model-free function of its generator, seed, and scale tier (§ 2.1 ; Appendix A.2 ), so the corpus can be regenerated exactly, at a median of 30 s of CPU time per environment and with no model calls. The generation stages are specified in § 2.1 ; task sources and the domain taxonomy in Appendix A.1 (Table 6 ); the coverage policy in Appendix A.3 ; the scale ladder and the measurement of horizon and difficulty in Appendices A.4 and A.5 ; the qualification gates in Appendix A.6 (Table 7 ); and per-domain statistics in Appendix A.7 (Table 8 ). Appendix A.10 walks through three complete training environments, each with its public view and the ground truth sealed behind it, so the construction can be followed end to end (the listings are excerpts of the package files). Reward and training. The progress potential and the shaped reward are fully specified by Eqs. ( 3 ) and ( 4 ). All three base models are publicly available and DPPO is a published objective; § 4.1 states the corpus each model is trained on, and Table 11 lists the hyperparameters shared by every run. Each ablation changes a single component of this recipe. Evaluation. All evaluation benchmarks are public. Appendix C.2 gives the harnesses, turn and token budgets, number of rollouts, and metric definitions; Appendix C.2 lists every task in ALE-CM and in the TB 3.0/4.0 “CM” subsets (Tables 12 and 13 ); and Appendix C.2 shows that the subsets track full-benchmark performance. The difficulty comparison of Table 1 follows Appendix A.8 , which fixes the evaluator, harness, sampling budget, and subsample seed, and train/evaluation overlap is measured with the protocol of Appendix A.9 .

paragraphs.en: Tev-Gym ’s generators target the seven computing-and-math subdomains of Agents’ Last Exam ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , which constitute ALE-CM and which we refer to throughout as Tev-Gym ’s seven domains: software engineering (9.1), data and analytics engineering (9.2), AI engineering, safety and CS research (9.3), mathematical and operations research (9.4), cybersecurity and digital forensics (9.5), infrastructure engineering and cloud operations (9.6), and quantum computing (9.7). Table 6 gives the scope of each and the deterministic signals it is verified by; subdomain ids and names are taken from the ALE taxonomy and the scope summaries follow it, reconstructed from O * NET/SOC 2018 and the released ALE task specifications. The coverage policy of Appendix A.3 requires every domain to be populated by at least two generators.
paragraphs.zh: Tev-Gym 的生成器针对“智能体最终考试”（Agents’ Last Exam，Sun 等人，2026 年）中的七个计算与数学子领域，这些子领域构成了 ALE-CM，并在全文中被称为 Tev-Gym 的七个领域：软件工程（9.1）、数据与分析工程（9.2）、人工智能工程、安全与计算机科学研究（9.3）、数学与运筹学（9.4）、网络安全与数字取证（9.5）、基础设施工程与云操作（9.6），以及量子计算（9.7）。 表 6 列出了每个子领域的范围及其验证所用的确定性信号；子领域 ID 和名称取自 ALE 分类体系，而范围总结则遵循该分类体系，并从 O*NET/SOC 2018 及已发布的 ALE 任务规范中重构而来。 附录 A.3 中的覆盖策略要求每个领域至少由两个生成器填充。

sents.en: Table 6 gives the scope of each and the deterministic signals it is verified by; subdomain ids and names are taken from the ALE taxonomy and the scope summaries follow it, reconstructed from O * NET/SOC 2018 and the released ALE task specifications.
sents.zh: 表 6 列出了每个子领域的范围及其验证所用的确定性信号；子领域 ID 和名称取自 ALE 分类体系，而范围总结则遵循该分类体系，并从 O*NET/SOC 2018 及已发布的 ALE 任务规范中重构而来。

sents.en: The coverage policy of Appendix A.3 requires every domain to be populated by at least two generators.
sents.zh: 附录 A.3 中的覆盖策略要求每个领域至少由两个生成器填充。

paragraphs.en: Sourcing. For every domain we assemble a pool of real task specifications: specifications mined from the internet, MLE-bench (82 Kaggle competitions), or, for domain 9.7 (quantum computing), which no benchmark suite covers, public reference material (MQT Bench’s circuit suite, Qiskit Experiments manuals, TeNPy’s DMRG examples). From this pool we randomly sample specifications and author our own generator around each selection: every generator is a fresh procedural design of our own, drawing on the sampled specification for structure and difficulty only, and never reproducing its prompt, input, answer, or grader text. A feasibility filter first restricts candidates to specifications whose ground truth is knowable by construction and executable batch/CPU-only, excluding live-service, vision/audio, heavy-toolchain, GPU-kernel, and open-ended “improve this” tasks; a similarity gate then compares every new generator’s code, specification, and generated data with all already-registered generators and rejects near-duplicates; and an adversarial review pass attacks each accepted generator’s specification for hidden shortcuts, too short a horizon, or a disguised source before implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 资源获取。 对于每个领域，我们都会组建一个真实任务规格的集合：这些规格来自互联网挖掘、MLE-bench（82个Kaggle竞赛），或者对于领域9.7（量子计算）——目前没有基准套件覆盖该领域——我们则使用公开参考材料（MQT Bench的电路套件、Qiskit Experiments手册以及TeNPy的DMRG示例）。 我们从这个集合中随机抽取规格，并为每个选中的规格设计我们自己的生成器：每个生成器都是我们全新的程序化设计，仅从所抽取的规格中借鉴结构和难度，而绝不会复制其提示、输入、答案或评分器文本。 首先，可行性过滤器会将候选规格限制为那些其基准答案可通过构造确定且仅用批处理/CPU即可执行的任务，排除实时服务、视觉/音频、依赖重型工具链、GPU内核以及开放式的“改进此任务”类任务；随后，相似性检查器会将每个新生成器的代码、规格和生成数据与所有已注册的生成器进行比较，并拒绝高度相似的重复项；最后，对抗性审查环节会在实施前，针对每个被接受的生成器的规格，检查其是否存在隐藏捷径、时间范围过短或伪装后的原始来源。

paragraphs.en: Every stage of § 2.1 is a pure, seeded function, and no language model participates in generation. Each generator’s code is authored once by coding agents and reviewed by the authors (see AI use statement); running it is model-free. An environment is therefore fully reproducible from its generator, seed, and scale tier, and two seeds of the same generator yield provably distinct worlds (the six-seed diversity gate of Appendix A.6 ). The cost of an environment therefore splits in two. A one-time authoring cost per generator is amortized over every seed and scale tier at which it is instantiated. The marginal cost is seconds of compute: producing one environment, including running both reference solvers, sealing the hidden suite, and previewing the progress potential Φ W \Phi_{W} , takes a median of 30 s of CPU time (90th percentile 82 s) and no model calls, against hours of expert time per hand-authored task. Each environment declares its toolchain (e.g., python3 , sqlite3 ) in its public contract, and the agent’s workspace is seeded only with its public tree.
paragraphs.zh: § 2.1 的每个阶段都是一个纯粹的、带有种子的函数，且没有任何语言模型参与生成。 每个生成器的代码由编码智能体一次性编写，并由作者进行审查（参见人工智能使用声明）；运行该代码无需依赖模型。 因此，一个环境可以通过其生成器、种子和规模层级完全复现，并且同一生成器的两个种子能够产生可证明不同的世界（附录 A.6 中的六种子多样性机制）。 因此，环境的成本被分为两部分。 每个生成器的一次性编写成本会分摊到其被实例化的所有种子和规模层级上。 边际成本仅为数秒的计算时间：生成一个环境（包括运行两个参考求解器、密封隐藏套件以及预览进展潜力 Φ W \Phi_{W}），中位数 CPU 时间为 30 秒（第 90 百分位为 82 秒），且无需任何模型调用，而人工编写的每个任务则需要数小时专家时间。 每个环境都会在其公开合同中声明其工具链（例如 python3、sqlite3），并且智能体的工作区仅通过其公开树进行初始化。

paragraphs.en: Every environment is labeled on 19 axes, the required axes of the corpus coverage policy: curriculum layer, subdomain, generator revision, scale tier, the four horizon axes (semantic, action, operational, verification), workflow stage, tool capability, artifact role, relation type, corruption class, source kind, license class, reward component, observed reward band, outcome category, and failure category. The corpus must satisfy a strength-2 covering array over these axes: for any two axes, every valid pair of their values co-occurs in at least one admitted environment. Coverage is extended greedily by choosing the generator, seed, and scale tier that fill the largest number of currently uncovered pairs, so “diverse” is a checkable property of the corpus rather than a claim. Pairwise coverage is what separates enforced from nominal diversity and rules out template locking ( Zeng et al., 2026a ) : a corpus can be balanced on every axis taken alone while its axis values only ever appear in a few fixed combinations; a strength-2 covering array rules this out for every pair of axes. Coverage is checked on admitted environments only, after the gates of Appendix A.6 . Appendix A.7 reports the resulting balance across domains and capability categories.
paragraphs.zh: 每个环境都在 19 个轴上被标注，这些轴是语料库覆盖策略所要求的：课程层、子领域、生成器版本、规模层级、四个时间范围轴（语义、动作、操作和验证）、工作流程阶段、工具能力、产物角色、关系类型、损坏类别、来源类型、许可类别、奖励组件、观测到的奖励区间、结果类别和失败类别。 该语料库必须在这些轴上满足强度为 2 的覆盖数组：对于任意两个轴，它们的所有有效值对至少在一个被接受的环境中同时出现。 覆盖通过贪心方式扩展：选择能够填补当前未覆盖配对数量最多的生成器、种子和规模层级，因此“多样性”是语料库的一个可验证属性，而非单纯的声明。 成对覆盖正是强制多样性与名义多样性之间的区别所在，并排除了模板锁定（Zeng et al., 2026a）：一个语料库可能在每个单独考察的轴上都保持平衡，但其各轴值可能仅出现在少数固定组合中；而强度为 2 的覆盖数组则排除了这种情况，适用于所有轴对。 覆盖性仅在通过附录 A.6 中的筛选条件后，针对被接受的环境进行检查。 附录 A.7 报告了由此产生的跨领域和跨能力类别的平衡情况。

paragraphs.en: Multi-format artifacts. Text-only tasks under-represent real terminal work, so each environment ships concrete, heterogeneous artifacts inspected through standard tooling: relational databases, columnar and delimited text, serialized model shards, compiled binaries, and service manifests. Some environments are also multimodal: part of the latent world is rendered as an image, such as the billing-dashboard screenshot of Example 1 (Appendix A.10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 多格式产物。 纯文本任务未能充分反映真实的终端操作，因此每个环境都会提供具体的、异构的产物，这些产物可通过标准工具进行检验：关系型数据库、列式及分隔符文本、序列化的模型碎片、编译后的二进制文件以及服务清单。 某些环境还支持多模态：潜在世界的一部分会被渲染为图像，例如示例 1（附录 A.10）中的账单仪表板截图。

paragraphs.en: Per-seed world variation. Re-seeding a generator varies entity identities, values, layouts, tensor names, and the placement of every corruption, so no two environments share a public tree (Appendix A.6 ). This is the mechanism behind both scale and decontamination.
paragraphs.zh: 种子前世界变化。 重新播种生成器会改变实体的身份、数值、布局、张量名称以及所有破坏项的位置，因此没有任何两个环境共享公共树（附录 A.6）。 这正是规模与去污染背后的机制。

paragraphs.en: Each generator exposes a scale axis that tunes the size of the world. For the warehouse environment the tiers run from 30 customers and 48 transactions per month (small) to 480 customers and 960 transactions per month (large), with proportional growth in duplicates and missing values; for the checkpoint-consolidation environment the ladder is the shard count crossed with the parallelism topology (pure tensor parallelism up to combined tensor-, pipeline-, and expert-parallel layouts). Because tasks are defined over the workflow DAG, typically five to six critical stages with cross-stage dependencies, the action, operational, and verification horizons grow with the tier as first-class, controllable quantities. We sample across the ladder so that the corpus is neither uniformly trivial nor uniformly unsolvable. For the generators instantiated at all three scale tiers, the median input tree grows from 17 files and 51 KB (unit) to 20 files and 168 KB (small) and 28 files and 586 KB (full) while the workflow DAG is unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 每个生成器都提供一个比例轴，用于调节世界的大小。 对于仓库环境，其层级范围从每月 30 名客户和 48 笔交易（小型）到每月 480 名客户和 960 笔交易（大型），同时重复项和缺失值也会成比例增长；对于检查点合并环境，其层级则是分片数量与并行拓扑的交叉组合（从纯张量并行到结合张量、管道和专家并行的布局）。 由于任务是在工作流有向无环图（DAG）上定义的，通常包含五个到六个具有跨阶段依赖的关键阶段，因此动作、操作和验证的时间范围会随着层级变化而增长，成为一等且可控的变量。 我们在整个层级范围内进行采样，以确保语料库既不会过于简单，也不会完全无法解决。 对于在所有三个比例层级上实例化的生成器，输入树的中间值从 17 个文件和 51 KB（单位级）增长到 20 个文件和 168 KB（小型），以及 28 个文件和 586 KB（完整级），而工作流有向无环图（DAG）保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Why we gate at generation time. The solver audit is independent of the verifier: neither π ref \pi^{\mathrm{ref}} nor π alt \pi^{\mathrm{alt}} imports verifier code, so their agreement is evidence about the specification rather than about the grader. Unlike pipelines that skip validation and rely on downstream RL to soft-filter unsolvable tasks ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) , we gate at generation time, because a dense progress signal is only useful if it is causal and resists gaming. Procedural seeding also makes decontamination structural: no two environments share a public tree, s 0 ​ ( E ) ≠ s 0 ​ ( E ′ ) s_{0}(E)\neq s_{0}(E^{\prime}) for E ≠ E ′ E\neq E^{\prime} , and none shares one with an evaluation instance (Appendix A.9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为何我们在生成阶段进行关卡控制。 求解器审计独立于验证器：既非 π ref \pi^{\mathrm{ref}} 也非 π alt \pi^{\mathrm{alt}} 引入验证器代码，因此它们的一致性反映的是对规范而非评分器的验证。 与跳过验证并依赖下游强化学习来软过滤无法解决的任务的管道方法不同（Ivison 等，2026），我们在生成阶段进行关卡控制，因为密集的前进信号只有在具有因果性且难以被操纵时才有用。 程序化种子设置也使去污染具有结构性：任何两个环境都不共享公共树，即对于 E ≠ E ′ E\neq E^{\prime}，有 s 0 ​ ( E ) ≠ s 0 ​ ( E ′ ) s_{0}(E)\neq s_{0}(E^{\prime})，且没有任何环境与评估实例共享公共树（附录 A.9）。

paragraphs.en: Difficulty. The same rollouts give the base-model difficulty: across our single-rollout probes (one per environment), 3.2% of environments are fully solved (mean graded score 0.06). Terminal reward alone is therefore near zero on most of the corpus, which is the regime § 3 addresses. Under the fixed evaluator of Appendix A.8 , Gemini 3.6 Flash reaches pass@1 29% and pass@8 40% on a fixed 92-environment subsample (Table 1 ), so the open–frontier gap is roughly 3 % 3\% against 29 % 29\% ; on 26 of those 92 environments, and on 52 further environments probed at the small and full scale tiers, it solves nothing and submits an answer in at most 29% of its rollouts, so a substantial part of Tev-Gym is beyond current frontier reach as authored.
paragraphs.zh: 难度。 相同的 rollout 给出了基础模型对应的难度：在我们单次 rollout 的探针中（每个环境一次），有 3.2% 的环境被完全解决（平均分级得分为 0.06）。 因此，在大多数语料中，仅靠终端奖励的值接近于零，这正是 § 3 所讨论的情形。 在附录 A.8 中定义的固定评估器下，Gemini 3.6 Flash 在一个包含 92 个环境的固定子样本上达到了 pass@1 29% 和 pass@8 40%（表 1），因此开放前沿与当前前沿之间的差距约为 3% 3\% 对 29% 29\%；在这些 92 个环境中的 26 个，以及在小型和完整规模层级中进一步探测的另外 52 个环境中，它没有任何解决，且最多只有 29% 的 rollout 会提交答案，因此 Tev-Gym 的相当一部分内容，按照当前版本而言，超出了当前前沿的能力范围。

sents.zh: 因此，在大多数语料中，仅靠终端奖励的值接近于零，这正是 § 3 所讨论的情形。

sents.en: Under the fixed evaluator of Appendix A.8 , Gemini 3.6 Flash reaches pass@1 29% and pass@8 40% on a fixed 92-environment subsample (Table 1 ), so the open–frontier gap is roughly 3 % 3\% against 29 % 29\% ; on 26 of those 92 environments, and on 52 further environments probed at the small and full scale tiers, it solves nothing and submits an answer in at most 29% of its rollouts, so a substantial part of Tev-Gym is beyond current frontier reach as authored.
sents.zh: 在附录 A.8 中定义的固定评估器下，Gemini 3.6 Flash 在一个包含 92 个环境的固定子样本上达到了 pass@1 29% 和 pass@8 40%（表 1），因此开放前沿与当前前沿之间的差距约为 3% 3\% 对 29% 29\%；在这些 92 个环境中的 26 个，以及在小型和完整规模层级中进一步探测的另外 52 个环境中，它没有任何解决，且最多只有 29% 的 rollout 会提交答案，因此 Tev-Gym 的相当一部分内容，按照当前版本而言，超出了当前前沿的能力范围。

paragraphs.en: Agent time. “Agent time” in Table 1 is measured rather than estimated. The fixed evaluator of the difficulty protocol below, Gemini 3.6 Flash, is run on a fixed 100-task subsample of each corpus, and for every rollout we record the wall-clock time from the agent’s first action to its last step. The interval includes every model call and retry and every command execution in between; it excludes only sandbox setup before the first action and the separate test run after the last step ( Tev-Gym ’s host-side grade at submission, 0.3 s at the median, falls inside the last step). The table reports the median and mean over rollouts, in minutes. For the prior corpora these are the rollouts of the difficulty measurement below (Harbor terminus-2 , 60 turns, 8 rollouts per task, timed by Harbor’s agent_execution interval). That budget ends only 1–13% of their rollouts, and every rollout it ends has already run longer than its corpus’s median, so the reported prior-corpus medians equal those of an unlimited budget (only the means could rise). Tev-Gym ’s rollouts run longer (28% use more than 60 tool calls), so for Tev-Gym we lift the budget until it no longer binds: we draw a fixed 100-environment subsample from all 1,170 environments (seed 20260915 , stratified by domain 9.1–9.7) and run the evaluator in the single- bash harness of § 4.1 with a budget of 300 tool calls and 2 h of agent wall-clock per rollout, 2 rollouts per environment. No rollout reaches either limit (median 41 tool calls, maximum 145), so the values are not truncated: median 12.4 min and mean 14.8 min, against a median of 0.5–2.0 min for the prior corpora. The measure compares corpora under one evaluator and is not an estimate of human effort. Terminal-Universe releases no environments and cannot be timed. “Progressive reward” marks a training signal defined on intermediate workspace states during an episode (§ 3 ); SETA’s test fraction is computed once at the end of the episode and therefore does not qualify.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体时间。表 1 中的“智能体时间”是测量所得，而非估算值。 下文难度协议中固定的评估器 Gemini 3.6 Flash 在每份语料库的固定 100 个任务子样本上运行；对于每次展开过程，我们记录从智能体的第一个动作到最后一个步骤所消耗的墙钟时间。 该时间区间包含所有模型调用、重试以及其间执行的每条命令；仅排除首次动作前的沙盒设置和最后一步之后的独立测试运行（Tev-Gym 提交时的主机端评分，中位数为 0.3 秒，属于最后一步的时间）。 表格报告了每次展开过程的中位数和平均值，单位是分钟。 对于先前的语料库，这些展开过程即下文难度测量的展开（Harbor terminus-2，60 轮次，每个任务 8 次展开，由 Harbor 的 agent_execution 区间计时）。 该预算仅在其展开过程的 1%–13% 中结束，且每次结束时的展开过程运行时间均已超过其语料库的中位数；因此，先前语料库报告的中位数等同于无限预算下的中位数（只有平均值可能上升）。 Tev-Gym 的展开过程运行时间更长（28% 的展开使用超过 60 次工具调用），因此对于 Tev-Gym，我们将预算提升直至其不再成为限制因素：我们从全部 1,170 个环境中抽取一个固定 100 环境的子样本（种子 20260915，按领域 9.1–9.7 分层），并在 § 4.1 的单 bash 容器中运行评估器，预算为每次展开 300 次工具调用和 2 小时智能体墙钟时间，每个环境运行 2 次展开。 没有任何展开过程达到任一限制（中位数为 41 次工具调用，最大值为 145 次），因此数值未被截断：中位数为 12.4 分钟，平均值为 14.8 分钟，而先前语料库的中位数为 0.5–2.0 分钟。 该指标是在单一评估器下比较不同语料库的，并非对人类努力程度的估算。 Terminal-Universe 未发布任何环境，因此无法计时。“渐进式奖励”指在单轮过程中基于中间工作区状态定义的训练信号（§ 3）；SETA 的测试比例仅在单轮结束时计算一次，因此不符合该定义。

paragraphs.en: Difficulty. We measure difficulty uniformly: a single evaluator, Gemini 3.6 Flash , is run on a fixed subsample of every corpus at an identical budget (60 tool calls, 8 rollouts per task, temperature 1.0), and we report pass@1 (mean over rollouts) and the unbiased pass@8 (macro over tasks). For Tev-Gym the evaluator runs in the single- bash harness of § 4.1 on a fixed 92-environment subsample, reaching pass@1 29% and pass@8 40%; it solves nothing on 26 of the 92, nor on the 52 further environments probed at the small and full tiers (Appendix A.7 ). For the prior corpora we run the same evaluator under the official Harbor terminus-2 agent on a fixed 100-task subsample of each (seed 20260915 , stratified by the corpus’s own domain or repository field where present): SETA 80/88 ( camel-ai/seta-env-release , CC BY-SA 4.0; 100/100 tasks), TMAX-15K 74/80 (pre-converted Harbor release of allenai/TMax-15K , ODC-BY; 100/100), Endless Terminals 83/89 ( obiwan96/endless-terminals , MIT; 99/100), SWE-Smith 47/52 ( SWE-bench/SWE-smith , MIT; 100/100), and CLI-Gym 69/74 ( LiberCoders/CLI-Gym , MIT; 89/100). Excluded are tasks the Docker sandbox cannot faithfully build: 11 CLI-Gym and 1 Endless tasks whose released Dockerfiles reference build-context files absent from the release or perform build-time /etc/hosts or /proc writes (these are CLI-Gym’s hardest systems-level corruptions, so its number is a mild upper bound); one TMAX task is under-sampled. Every exclusion is recorded. Terminal-Universe is a task-generation method whose 32k environments are not publicly released, so its difficulty could not be measured and its cells are marked NA. The evaluator and budget are shared across all rows; only the scaffold differs (prior corpora terminus-2 , Tev-Gym single- bash ). Sizes are as reported by each corpus; “oracle” names what grades a task and “grading metric” what it emits to a learner, and a corpus is credited with a progressive reward only if it emits more than a terminal scalar.
paragraphs.zh: 难度。 我们以统一方式衡量难度：对每个语料库的固定子样本运行单个评估器 Gemini 3.6 Flash，预算保持一致（每次任务 60 次工具调用、8 次展开，温度设为 1.0），并报告 pass@1（各展开结果的均值）和无偏 pass@8（所有任务的宏观平均值）。 对于 Tev-Gym，评估器在 §4.1 所述的单 bash 框架中运行，作用于一个包含 92 个环境的固定子样本，最终 pass@1 为 29%，pass@8 为 40%；在 92 个环境中，有 26 个完全无法解决，而在后续小规模和完整层级中测试的另外 52 个环境中也未能解决（附录 A.7）。 对于此前的语料库，我们在官方 Harbor terminus-2 智能体下运行相同的评估器，作用于每个语料库的固定 100 个任务的子样本（种子为 20260915，按语料库自身的领域或存在的仓库字段进行分层）：SETA 80/88（camel-ai/seta-env-release，CC BY-SA 4.0；100/100 任务），TMAX-15K 74/80（allenai/TMax-15K 的预先转换版 Harbor 发布版本，ODC-BY；100/100），Endless Terminals 83/89（obiwan96/endless-terminals，MIT；99/100），SWE-Smith 47/52（SWE-bench/SWE-smith，MIT；100/100），以及 CLI-Gym 69/74（LiberCoders/CLI-Gym，MIT；89/100）。 被排除的任务包括 Docker 沙盒无法完整构建的任务：11 个 CLI-Gym 任务和 1 个 Endless 任务，其发布的 Dockerfile 引用了发布版本中缺失的构建上下文文件，或在构建时执行了 /etc/hosts 或 /proc 的写入操作（这些是 CLI-Gym 中最具挑战性的系统级破坏性任务，因此其数量仅是一个温和的上限）；此外，还有一个 TMAX 任务的样本量不足。 所有排除情况均已记录。 Terminal-Universe 是一种任务生成方法，其包含的 3.2 万个环境并未公开发布，因此无法衡量其难度，相关单元格标记为 NA。 评估器和预算在所有行中保持一致；仅框架不同（此前语料库使用 terminus-2，Tev-Gym 使用单 bash）。 规模数据来自各语料库的报告；“oracle”指用于判断任务是否完成的标准，“grading metric”指任务向学习者输出的内容，且只有当语料库输出的内容超过终端标量时，才会被计为具有渐进式奖励。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 complements the size and difficulty comparison with the axes on which generation pipelines differ in design: what anchors generation, whether a model is in the loop, what admits a task and when, whether difficulty and coverage are controlled or only reported, and what a learner receives short of a terminal pass.
paragraphs.zh: 表9从生成管道在设计上存在差异的维度，补充了规模与难度的比较：生成以何为锚点、模型是否处于循环中、何种任务在何时被接受、难度与覆盖范围是受控控制还是仅被报告，以及学习者在未通过最终阶段前能获得什么。

paragraphs.en: Structural cleanliness. Because each task is projected from a freshly seeded procedural world, no two environments, and in particular no environment and no evaluation instance, share a public tree; the six-seed diversity gate enforces this by hash. Tev-Gym therefore contains no verbatim copy of any evaluation task.
paragraphs.zh: 结构纯净性。 由于每个任务都是从全新初始化的过程世界中投射出来的，因此没有任何两个环境（尤其是任何环境与任何评估实例）共享公共树；六种子多样性门通过哈希强制执行这一规则。 因此，Tev-Gym 不包含任何评估任务的逐字复制品。

paragraphs.en: Measured overlap. We additionally measure lexical overlap between the task prompt of every one of the 1,170 environments and our evaluation sets with a 13-gram sliding window over lower-cased alphanumeric tokens, following standard contamination protocol. The evaluation texts are the task cards of the 18 computing-and-math tasks (and, as a superset, all 23 tasks of that split; 9,010 distinct 13-grams), the instructions of the 74 TB 3.0/4.0 tasks (21,138) and of the 89 TB 2.1 tasks (13,292). No environment shares a single 13-gram with any evaluation task (0 of 1,170 against each set; maximum shared fraction 0.0%), and none shares an 8-gram; overlap appears only at 5-grams, in generic phrasing such as “not modify files under input”. A control confirms that the comparator is sensitive: the two TB sets share 156 13-grams with each other.
paragraphs.zh: 已测量的重叠度。 我们还采用标准污染协议，通过在下拉小写字母数字词元上滑动一个 13-gram 窗口，测量每个 1,170 个环境的任务提示与我们评估集之间的词汇重叠度。 评估文本包括 18 个计算与数学任务的任务卡（以及作为其超集的该分集中全部 23 个任务；共 9,010 个不同的 13-gram），74 个 TB 3.0/4.0 任务的说明（21,138 个）以及 89 个 TB 2.1 任务的说明（13,292 个）。 没有任何一个环境与任何评估任务共享单个 13-gram（每个集合中 1,170 个环境均无共享；最大共享比例为 0.0%），也没有任何环境共享 8-gram；重叠仅出现在 5-gram 上，例如“不要修改输入下的文件”这类通用表述。 一项对照实验证实了比较器具有敏感性：两个 TB 集合彼此之间共享了 156 个 13-gram。

sents.en: Measured overlap.

sents.en: We additionally measure lexical overlap between the task prompt of every one of the 1,170 environments and our evaluation sets with a 13-gram sliding window over lower-cased alphanumeric tokens, following standard contamination protocol.

sents.en: The evaluation texts are the task cards of the 18 computing-and-math tasks (and, as a superset, all 23 tasks of that split; 9,010 distinct 13-grams), the instructions of the 74 TB 3.0/4.0 tasks (21,138) and of the 89 TB 2.1 tasks (13,292).

sents.en: No environment shares a single 13-gram with any evaluation task (0 of 1,170 against each set; maximum shared fraction 0.0%), and none shares an 8-gram; overlap appears only at 5-grams, in generic phrasing such as “not modify files under input”.

sents.en: A control confirms that the comparator is sensitive: the two TB sets share 156 13-grams with each other.

The calibration block applies the same code to a task scored against the other tasks of its own benchmark, which shares a 13-gram in every TB case (the common closing instruction) and reaches a nearest-neighbor Jaccard of 0.37 0.37 . Against that scale, no evaluation task shares an 8-gram with any environment, and nearest-neighbor similarity to the whole dataset stays at 0.13 0.13 (median) and 0.18 0.18 (maximum) on TB 3.0 and 4.0 and 0.10 0.10 and 0.16 0.16 on TB 2.1; on ALE-CM it is 0.22 0.22 and 0.38 0.38 .

paragraphs.en: Two generalizations of § 2.1 are easiest to see on concrete environments. First, the public tree s 0 s_{0} need not be text: Example 1, a cloud-operations task from one of Tev-Gym ’s seven domains, stages a billing-dashboard screenshot whose three findings appear in no CSV. Second, nothing in the pipeline is specific to the seven computing-and-math domains: Examples 2 and 3 were synthesized by the same pipeline for two other domains of Agents’ Last Exam ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , energy engineering (closed-loop building control) and accounting (financial-statement reconstruction). For each we present the training environment only, in two parts: the public view , the prompt x x and the input tree s 0 s_{0} that are all the agent ever receives, and the ground truth sealed behind them, the latent world W W , the reference deliverables derived from it, and what the grader compares. The three also span the two ways a latent world grounds a reference: in Examples 1 and 3 the world is a generated record set and the reference follows from it by construction; in Example 2 the world is a pinned simulator plus a declared procedure, so the reference is a tool oracle , produced by running that procedure once inside the sealed image. Paths are relative to the agent’s working directory, the agent writes its deliverables to output/ , and all three run in a pinned container with the network disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 对 § 2.1 的两个推广，在具体的环境中最容易理解。 首先，公共树 s₀ s_{0} 不必是文本：示例 1 是 Tev-Gym 七个领域之一中的云操作任务，它展示了一个计费仪表板的截图，其中的三个发现并未以 CSV 形式出现。 其次，流程中的任何内容都不局限于计算与数学这七个领域：示例 2 和 3 由同一流程为“智能体最终考试”（Sun et al., 2026）的其他两个领域合成，即能源工程（闭环建筑控制）和会计（财务报表重建）。 对于每个领域，我们仅展示训练环境，分为两部分：公共视图，即提示 x x 和输入树 s₀ s_{0}，这些是智能体唯一接收到的内容；以及被其掩盖的基准真相，即潜在世界 W W、由此派生出的参考交付物，以及评分器所依据的比较标准。 这三个示例也涵盖了潜在世界为参考提供依据的两种方式：在示例 1 和 3 中，世界是一个生成的记录集，而参考则是通过构造直接从该记录集得出；在示例 2 中，世界是一个固定的模拟器加上一个声明的程序，因此参考是一个工具预言机，通过在密封图像中运行该程序一次生成。 路径是相对于智能体的工作目录的，智能体将其交付物写入 output/ 目录，且三者均在网络禁用的固定容器中运行。

The agent receives the prompt below and three inputs: an inventory CSV of 430 EC2, RDS, and S3 resources with utilization percentiles, a pricing table, and a rendered billing-dashboard screenshot (Figure 6 ) whose lower panel lists three findings, an idle NAT gateway, an unattached Elastic IP, and a stale CloudWatch log group, that appear in no CSV. paragraphs.en: Ground truth. The latent world W W is the generator’s record of the fleet: the 430 inventory rows with their utilization percentiles and sizes, the pricing tiers in their declared order, and three planted dashboard-only findings with their dashboard-reported costs. Rendering splits W W across three formats: the inventory becomes resource_usage.csv , the tiers become aws_pricing_reference.csv , and the three findings are drawn only into the PNG, next to a per-service cost table that is context, so that no text file contains them. The reference follows from W W by applying the prompt’s four rules with the pricing table: 730 hours per month, one tier down along the declared order, S3 Standard to Infrequent Access per GB-month, and recommendations sorted by savings descending, then by id. Each recommendation’s current cost, projected cost, and savings are computed from unrounded prices and rounded to cents separately, so a row’s savings can differ by one cent from the difference of its two rounded costs ( s3-000126 , 7,734 GB: 177.88 − 96.68 = 81.20 177.88-96.68=81.20 , savings 81.21). Of the six rows above, three qualify: db-000048 (CPU 18.48, 8 connections) drops to db.m5.large and saves 124.83; i-000000 (CPU 11.97, memory 41.34) drops to m5.xlarge and saves 140.16; s3-000015 (5,923 GB at 5.2% infrequent access) moves to Infrequent Access and saves 62.19. For this seed the rules yield 148 recommendations, 74 EC2 downsizes, 27 RDS downsizes, 44 S3 tier moves, and the three dashboard findings. The executive summary sums the rounded rows column by column: current cost 32,629.73 USD, projected cost 16,234.79, and monthly savings 16,395.02. The savings total therefore exceeds current minus projected (16,394.94) by 0.08, the sum of the one-cent residues on 12 S3 rows, far inside the grader’s 20% savings tolerance. The grader applies two hard gates (both files parse and are non-empty; total savings lie between zero and total current cost), then scores the weighted rubric the prompt announces: coverage F1 of recommended ids against the hidden set (30%), action correctness on matched ids (30%), savings accuracy with full credit within 20% relative error and linear decay to zero at 100% (25%), and completeness of the summary fields, per-recommendation columns, and CSV header (15%); it also reports recall of the three dashboard-only ids separately, accepting the CloudWatch id as printed on the dashboard as an alias of the canonical id.
paragraphs.zh: 真实数据。 潜在世界 W W 是生成器对舰队状态的记录：包含 430 行库存数据及其利用率分位数和规模、按声明顺序排列的定价层级，以及三项仅存在于仪表盘的植入性发现及其在仪表盘上报告的成本。 将 W W 拆分为三种格式：库存数据转为 resource_usage.csv，定价层级转为 aws_pricing_reference.csv，而三项发现仅被提取到 PNG 图像中，并置于按服务分类的成本表旁作为上下文信息，因此没有任何文本文件包含这些发现。 参考结果通过应用提示词中的四条规则并结合定价表从 W W 推导得出：每月 730 小时、沿声明顺序向下调整一个层级、每 GB-月将 S3 Standard 转为 Infrequent Access，以及按节省金额降序排序、再按 ID 排序的推荐项。 每项推荐的当前成本、预测成本和节省金额均基于未四舍五入的价格计算，并分别四舍五入到美分，因此某行的节省金额可能与两行四舍五入后成本之差相差一个美分（s3-000126，7,734 GB：177.88 − 96.68 = 81.20，节省金额为 81.21）。 在上述六行中，有三行符合条件：db-000048（CPU 18.48，8 个连接）降级为 db.m5.large，节省 124.83；i-000000（CPU 11.97，内存 41.34）降级为 m5.xlarge，节省 140.16；s3-000015（5,923 GB，5.2% 低频访问）转为 Infrequent Access，节省 62.19。 对于此种子数据，这些规则生成了 148 项推荐，包括 74 项 EC2 降级、27 项 RDS 降级、44 项 S3 层级调整，以及三项仪表盘发现。 执行摘要按列对四舍五入后的各行数据进行求和：当前成本为 32,629.73 美元，预测成本为 16,234.79 美元，每月节省金额为 16,395.02 美元。 因此，总节省金额比“当前成本减去预测成本”（16,394.94）多出了 0.08，这是 12 行 S3 数据中每个 1 美分余数之和，远低于评分器设定的 20% 节省容差。 评分器首先应用两个硬性条件（两个文件均能解析且非空；总节省金额介于零与总当前成本之间），然后根据提示词中声明的加权评分标准进行打分：推荐 ID 在隐藏集合中的覆盖 F1 分数（30%）、匹配 ID 上的操作正确性（30%）、在相对误差 20% 以内完全准确时获得全额积分、误差达 100% 时线性衰减至零的节省准确性（25%），以及摘要字段、每项推荐对应的列和 CSV 表头的完整性（15%）；此外，评分器还会单独报告对三个仅存在于仪表盘中的 ID 的召回率，并将仪表盘上显示的 CloudWatch ID 视为标准 ID 的别名。

sents.en: The savings total therefore exceeds current minus projected (16,394.94) by 0.08, the sum of the one-cent residues on 12 S3 rows, far inside the grader’s 20% savings tolerance.
sents.zh: 因此，总节省金额比“当前成本减去预测成本”（16,394.94）多出了 0.08，这是 12 行 S3 数据中每个 1 美分余数之和，远低于评分器设定的 20% 节省容差。

sents.en: The grader applies two hard gates (both files parse and are non-empty; total savings lie between zero and total current cost), then scores the weighted rubric the prompt announces: coverage F1 of recommended ids against the hidden set (30%), action correctness on matched ids (30%), savings accuracy with full credit within 20% relative error and linear decay to zero at 100% (25%), and completeness of the summary fields, per-recommendation columns, and CSV header (15%); it also reports recall of the three dashboard-only ids separately, accepting the CloudWatch id as printed on the dashboard as an alias of the canonical id.
sents.zh: 评分器首先应用两个硬性条件（两个文件均能解析且非空；总节省金额介于零与总当前成本之间），然后根据提示词中声明的加权评分标准进行打分：推荐 ID 在隐藏集合中的覆盖 F1 分数（30%）、匹配 ID 上的操作正确性（30%）、在相对误差 20% 以内完全准确时获得全额积分、误差达 100% 时线性衰减至零的节省准确性（25%），以及摘要字段、每项推荐对应的列和 CSV 表头的完整性（15%）；此外，评分器还会单独报告对三个仅存在于仪表盘中的 ID 的召回率，并将仪表盘上显示的 CloudWatch ID 视为标准 ID 的别名。

paragraphs.en: output_contract.json names the nine deliverables and fixes their schemas.
paragraphs.zh: output_contract.json 命名了九个交付成果并确定了它们的模式。

paragraphs.en: Ground truth. The latent world is the pinned simulator together with the declared procedure: the EnergyPlus model, the weather file, and the schedules, weights, and identification recipe of instance.json fix a unique correct value for every field of the nine deliverables. The reference is therefore produced by executing that procedure once, inside the same pinned image, by the sealed reference builder, which the agent never sees. The builder (i) checks the SHA-256 of the shipped 1ZoneUncontrolled.idf and Golden TMY3 weather file against the values pinned in instance.json and applies the declared edits to the model (run period 1–7 July, four timesteps per hour, an InternalMass of 48 m 2 , and a Schedule:Constant actuator driving a 2.0406 2.0406 kW OtherEquipment cooling sink); (ii) runs EnergyPlus twice through its Python API, once under the two-position thermostat (declared setpoint schedule, deadband 0.5 ∘ C, on-fraction 0.85) and once under the prescribed 0.9/0.1 excitation schedule, reading the zone temperature and writing the actuator at every zone timestep; (iii) fits the declared second-order input–output model
paragraphs.zh: 基准真值。 潜在世界由固定的模拟器以及声明的流程共同构成：EnergyPlus 模型、天气文件，以及 instance.json 中的调度、权重和识别方案，为九个交付物的每个字段确定一个唯一且正确的值。 因此，参考结果是通过密封的参考构建器在同一固定镜像中执行该流程一次而生成的，而智能体从未见过该构建器。 构建器（i）将已发布的 1ZoneUncontrolled.idf 和 Golden TMY3 天气文件的 SHA-256 哈希值与 instance.json 中固定的值进行比对，并对模型应用声明的修改（运行周期为 7 月 1 日至 7 日，每小时四个时间步长，内部质量为 48 m²，以及一个 Schedule:Constant 执行器驱动功率为 2.0406 kW 的 OtherEquipment 冷却负荷）；（ii）通过其 Python API 两次运行 EnergyPlus：一次在双位置恒温器条件下（声明的设定值调度、死区为 0.5°C、开启分率为 0.85），另一次在预定的 0.9/0.1 激励调度下，在每个区域时间步长读取区域温度并写入执行器；（iii）拟合声明的二阶输入-输出模型。
