paragraphs.en: by ridge least squares ( λ = 10 − 8 \lambda=10^{-8} ) on the first 80% of each trace with the last 20% held out, and asserts a negative cooling gain, c 0 + c 1 < 0 c_{0}+c_{1}<0 ; (iv) runs EnergyPlus twice more in closed loop, solving at every zone timestep a 24-step cvxpy/OSQP receding-horizon problem with the policy’s declared weights and actuating its first control; and (v) writes the nine artifacts with the declared rounding: three 672-row traces, two 96-row action files over the final 24 hours, two logs exposing the seven coefficients, training and held-out RMSE, closed-loop one-step RMSE, objective weights, and solver-status counts, the 3 × 7 3\times 7 metrics table, and the summary. A round-trip self-check re-fits the model and re-reads every artifact the way the grader will (coefficients within 10 − 7 10^{-7} , row counts, distinct policy weights) before the environment is published. The grader then compares the agent’s nine files with these references cell by cell (CSV) and leaf by leaf (JSON) at a tolerance of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , scoring each artifact by its fraction of matching fields. Every artifact is a function of the closed-loop trajectories, so a precomputed open-loop schedule, a first-order model, or a single policy cannot reproduce them.
paragraphs.zh: 对每条轨迹的前 80% 使用带岭项的最小二乘法（λ = 10⁻⁸）进行拟合，并将最后 20% 的数据保留；同时断言冷却增益为负，即 c₀ + c₁ < 0；(iv) 在闭环中再运行 EnergyPlus 两次，在每个区域的时间步上求解一个包含 24 个步骤的 cvxpy/OSQP 滚动规划问题，使用策略声明的权重并执行其首个控制动作；以及 (v) 按照声明的精度要求写入九个输出文件：三个每行 672 行的轨迹文件、两个涵盖最后 24 小时且每行 96 行的动作文件、两个揭示七个系数、训练与保留数据的 RMSE、闭环单步 RMSE、目标权重和求解器状态计数的日志文件，以及一个 3×7 的指标表和摘要。 在环境发布之前，一次往返自检查会重新拟合模型，并以评分系统将采用的方式重新读取每个输出文件（系数精度在 10⁻⁷ 以内、行数一致、策略权重唯一）。 随后，评分系统将以 10⁻⁴ 的容差，逐单元格（CSV 格式）和逐叶子节点（JSON 格式）地将智能体的九个文件与这些参考文件进行比较，并根据每个输出文件的匹配字段比例进行评分。 每个输出文件都是闭环轨迹的函数，因此预计算的开环时间表、一阶模型或单一策略都无法重现它们。

paragraphs.en: The policy document is the agent’s only statement of precedence.
paragraphs.zh: 政策文件是智能体唯一具有优先效力的声明。

paragraphs.en: The excerpts below follow one line item, cash and cash equivalents for FY2025, through the packet: under its balance-sheet concept it is reported five times with four different values.
paragraphs.zh: 以下摘录在文件中依次列出了2025财年的“现金及现金等价物”这一单行项目：根据其资产负债表概念，该项目被五次报告，且数值各不相同，共有四个不同的值。

paragraphs.en: Ground truth. The latent world W W is the company’s true two-period statements: 16 integer line items in USD millions for fiscal years 2025 and 2024, each ending December 31. W W satisfies the three identities the prompt asks the agent to verify, assets = = liabilities + + equity, net income = = revenue − - cost of revenue − - operating expenses, and ending cash = = beginning cash + + operating + + investing + + financing cash flow, as well as the ties that connect real statements: the four asset lines sum to total assets (FY2025: 246 + 147 + 62 + 732 = 1,187 246+147+62+732=1{,}187 ), balance-sheet cash equals cash-flow ending cash in each year (246 and 256), and FY2025 beginning cash equals FY2024 ending cash (256). Rendering projects W W into the two public formats: each value becomes a whole-dollar structured fact under its us-gaap concept in companyfacts.json and an inline-XBRL row, in millions and with a stable fragment id, in the fiscal year’s 10-K. The defect plan then corrupts the clean packet, but only in sources that the policy rejects. The original FY2025 10-K misstates three balance-sheet lines, in its rows and in its structured facts alike (cash 239, accounts receivable 138, other current assets 726, against 246, 147, and 732 in W W ); a 10-K/A restates one row (cash, 239 → \to 243), and the restated value is still wrong; the whole FY2025 fact set is refiled in companyfacts.json under the 10-K/A accession with the true values, so the structured feed and the amendment disagree about the same restatement; an 8-K reports the same concepts under quarterly Q32025 contexts; the filings carry an “unaudited supplemental data” section; outflows are printed in accounting parentheses, (110) ; and each line item admits a second, company-extension concept ( jrh: ) that this seed leaves unused. Because the defect plan is declared, the correct resolution of each of these is known without running a solver, and the three reference deliverables follow from W W , the defect plan, and the policy text. Since every defect lies in a rejected source, the values the policy selects are those of W W , and financial_statements.json is W W itself. The rejected values are also the ones that break the ties: the original 10-K’s asset lines sum to 1,165 against its total assets of 1,187, and neither 239 nor 243 matches the ending cash of 246.
paragraphs.zh: 真实数据。 潜在世界 W W 是公司真实的两期财务报表：包含 2025 和 2024 财年（均截至 12 月 31 日）的 16 个以百万美元计量的整数报表项目。 W W 满足提示要求智能体验证的三个恒等式：资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益，净利润 = 收入 − 收入成本 − 运营费用，以及期末现金 = 期初现金 + 经营现金流 + 投资现金流 + 融资现金流；同时，它还满足连接真实报表的各项关联关系：四个资产项目之和等于总资产（2025 财年：246 + 147 + 62 + 732 = 1,187），资产负债表中各年的现金金额与现金流量表中的期末现金一致（分别为 246 和 256），且 2025 财年的期初现金等于 2024 财年的期末现金（256）。 将项目 W W 转换为两种公开格式：每个数值都成为 companyfacts.json 中对应 us-gaap 概念下的整美元结构化事实，并在该财年 10-K 报告中以百万为单位、附带稳定片段 ID 的形式作为内联 XBRL 行呈现。 随后，缺陷计划会破坏这个干净的数据包，但仅影响策略所拒绝的来源。 原始的 2025 财年 10-K 报告在报表行和结构化事实中均错误陈述了三个资产负债表项目（现金为 239、应收账款为 138、其他流动资产为 726，而 W W 中的对应数值为 246、147 和 732）；一份 10-K/A 修正报告更正了一个报表行（现金从 239 → 243），但修正后的数值仍然错误；整个 2025 财年的事实数据集已根据真实值在 companyfacts.json 中通过 10-K/A 访问标识重新提交，因此结构化数据流与修正案对同一修正项存在分歧；一份 8-K 报告在 2025 年第三季度（Q32025）的背景下报告了相同概念；这些文件包含“未经审计的补充数据”部分；流出金额以会计括号形式显示为 (110)；且每个报表项目都允许一个由公司扩展定义的第二个概念（jrh:），但本初始数据未使用它。 由于缺陷计划已明确声明，无需运行求解器即可确定这些问题的正确解决方案；而三个参考交付物则可由 W W、缺陷计划和策略文本直接得出。 由于所有缺陷都存在于被拒绝的来源中，因此策略所选择的数值即为 W W 的数值，且 financial_statements.json 本身就是 W W。 被拒绝的数值也正是破坏关联关系的数值：原始 10-K 报告中的资产项目之和为 1,165，与其总资产 1,187 不符；且 239 和 243 均与期末现金 246 不匹配。

paragraphs.en: Relation to potential-based shaping. In the language of potential-based shaping ( Ng et al., 1999 ) , Φ \Phi is the potential and r t r_{t} its difference. Classical shaping requires that the shaped objective have the same optimal policies as the original; we deliberately do not, because the whole point is that the shaped objective is not indifferent to partial progress. What we retain is agreement on maximizers (any passing rollout outscores any failing one) and anchoring ( Φ = 1 \Phi=1 exactly when the verifier passes), so the acceptance set of a task is unchanged. This is the opposite route from the usual remedy for tasks beyond a learner’s frontier, which is to simplify, scaffold, or defer the task until some rollout succeeds ( Florensa et al., 2018 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Wolf et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026a ) ; we leave the task and the harness fixed and raise the resolution of the reward. We prefer a task-aligned potential to the test-pass fraction of Shen et al. (2026) and the passing-assertion count of Yang et al. (2026) , which score only what the terminal tests probe and carry no notion of regression. The signal is also denser within a group that contains a success: the lone passing rollout is contrasted not with an undifferentiated mass of failures but with a graded spectrum of near-misses. Because Φ \Phi is produced by a scorer with a code closure disjoint from the verifier’s and has passed the causality and exploit-resistance gates of Appendix A.6 , none of the probed gaming strategies applied to the public tree earns Φ > 0 \Phi>0 , and Φ \Phi rises only when the output tree matches more of the workflow’s correct intermediate and final artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 与基于势的塑造方法的关系。在基于势的塑造方法（Ng et al., 1999）的术语中，Φ 是势函数，而 r_t 是其差值。传统的塑造方法要求被塑造的目标函数与原目标函数具有相同的最优策略；但我们有意不这样做，因为这种方法的核心在于：被塑造的目标函数并非对部分进展无动于衷。我们保留的是在最大化策略上的一致性（任何通过的回滚执行都优于任何失败的回滚执行），以及锚定特性（当且仅当验证器通过时，Φ = 1）。因此，任务的可接受集保持不变。这与处理学习者能力边界之外任务的常规方法恰恰相反——后者通常会简化、搭建脚手架或推迟任务，直到有回滚执行成功为止（Florensa et al., 2018；Chen et al., 2025b；Wolf et al., 2026；Zeng et al., 2026a）；而我们则保持任务和框架不变，仅提升奖励的分辨率。相比于 Shen et al.（2026）提出的测试通过率以及 Yang et al.（2026）提出的通过断言次数，我们更倾向于采用与任务对齐的势函数，因为后者仅对终端测试所探测的内容进行评分，且不包含任何关于退化的概念。此外，在包含成功案例的组别中，这种信号也更为密集：唯一的成功回滚执行并非与一个未加区分的失败集合进行比较，而是与一系列渐进式的“差一点成功”进行比较。由于 Φ 是由一个评分器生成的，其代码闭包与验证器的代码闭包相互独立，并且已经通过了附录 A.6 中的因果性和抗利用性检验，因此任何应用于公开树结构的探测性博弈策略都无法获得 Φ > 0；只有当输出树结构与工作流程中更多正确的中间产物和最终产物相匹配时，Φ 才会上升。

paragraphs.en: ALE-CM consists of 18 expert-authored long-horizon tasks in three capability categories (Math & Science, 8 tasks; ML, 5; Coding & System, 5), each graded in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by its own strict grader. Every Qwen model, base or trained, runs in Vanillux2 , the single- bash harness used in training, with 64 turns and 16,384 tokens per turn and 5 independent rollouts per task. Frontier models run in their native agent harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI), the setting most favorable to them; the largest open model, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, runs in Vanillux2. We report the mean graded score ( S@1 ), the fraction of rollouts that fully solve the task ( P@1 ), and their best-of-5 counterparts ( S@5 , P@5 ). On TB 3.0 and 4.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Marten et al., 2026 ; Marten, 2026 ) we evaluate the “CM” subsets (22 and 18 tasks; selection described below); on TB 2.1 (89 tasks) we use the benchmark’s reference agent Terminus-2 for the 27B models and Vanillux2 for the 9B models, with k = 5 k{=}5 . Task selection and scoring conventions are given in the table captions.

paragraphs.en: Selection of the “CM” subsets and task lists. Our training generators cover one domain, computing and math, while TB 3.0 spans many, so we evaluate on the TB tasks that fall in that domain. To select them we gave Claude the 74 TB 3.0 task directories together with a description of our computing-and-math domains and asked it to judge, task by task, whether the task belongs to that domain even just slightly; we keep the in-domain tasks that our CPU-only harness can run and grade. This gives the 22-task TB 3.0 subset, and the 18 of these tasks that remain in TB 4.0 form the TB 4.0 subset. The computing-and-math split of Agents’ Last Exam has 23 tasks, and ALE-CM keeps the 18 that run in a Linux Docker container, the sandbox of our training and evaluation harness. The other five need a full virtual machine, which that sandbox does not provide. Four boot a Windows 10 guest to analyze Windows binaries or packet captures with desktop tools such as IDA, Ghidra, x64dbg, and Wireshark ( ghidra_malware_config_extraction_01 , pcap_enterprise_triage_01 , tris_crackme , newyear_keygen2 ); the fifth, k8s_migration_1 , boots an Ubuntu 22 guest to run a Minikube cluster on Docker, which would require Docker inside our container. The exclusion follows from the runtime alone, not from task difficulty, and every model in Table 2 , ours and frontier, is scored on the same 18 tasks. The 18 ALE-CM tasks are listed in Table 12 and the TB subsets in Table 13 .
paragraphs.zh: “CM”子集和任务列表的选择。 我们的训练生成器覆盖一个领域——计算与数学，而 TB 3.0 涵盖多个领域，因此我们在属于该领域的 TB 任务上进行评估。 为了筛选这些任务，我们将 74 个 TB 3.0 任务目录以及我们对计算与数学领域的描述提供给 Claude，并要求它逐个判断每个任务是否哪怕只是略微属于该领域；我们保留那些仅使用 CPU 的测试框架能够运行和评分的领域内任务。 这样便得到了包含 22 个任务的 TB 3.0 子集，其中仍有 18 个任务存在于 TB 4.0 中，这些任务构成了 TB 4.0 子集。 “Agents’ Last Exam”的计算与数学分支包含 23 个任务，而 ALE-CM 保留了其中可以在 Linux Docker 容器中运行的 18 个任务，该容器是我们训练和评估框架的沙盒环境。 其余五个任务需要完整的虚拟机，而该沙盒环境无法提供。 其中四个任务会启动一个 Windows 10 虚拟机，以便使用 IDA、Ghidra、x64dbg 和 Wireshark 等桌面工具分析 Windows 二进制文件或网络抓包（ghidra_malware_config_extraction_01、pcap_enterprise_triage_01、tris_crackme、newyear_keygen2）；第五个任务 k8s_migration_1 则会启动一个 Ubuntu 22 虚拟机，在 Docker 上运行 Minikube 集群，而这需要在我们的容器内部安装 Docker。 这种排除仅基于运行时环境，而非任务难度，并且表 2 中的所有模型——包括我们的模型和前沿模型——都在相同的 18 个任务上进行评分。 18 个 ALE-CM 任务列于表 12，TB 子集则列于表 13。

paragraphs.en: Representativeness of the “CM” subsets. Tables 14 and 15 compare, for every official leaderboard row of Table 3 , its score on our 22-task (TB 3.0) and 18-task (TB 4.0) subsets with its score on the full 74- and 66-task benchmarks. Both sides are computed from the same official per-trial results (5 trials per task, ungraded trials scored 0, P@1 the per-task mean reward and P@5 the unbiased pass@5 estimator, macro-averaged over tasks); the full-set P@1 reproduces the leaderboard’s published accuracy to within 0.01 0.01 (the residual comes from trials the leaderboard re-scored after our snapshot). GLM 5.2 has no TB 4.0 entry, and our own Gemini and Qwen runs are not leaderboard rows, so they are omitted. Subset scores run somewhat above full-set scores for most models, but the two agree closely on how models compare: across models, Pearson r r (linear agreement of the scores) is 0.96 0.96 (P@1) and 0.89 0.89 (P@5) on TB 3.0 and 0.97 0.97 and 0.92 0.92 on 4.0, and Spearman ρ \rho (agreement of the model ranking) is 0.94 0.94 / 0.83 0.83 and 0.90 0.90 / 0.91 0.91 .
paragraphs.zh: “CM”子集的代表性。 表14和表15对表3中每一行官方排行榜数据进行了比较，分别比较了其在我们的22任务（TB 3.0）和18任务（TB 4.0）子集上的得分与在完整74任务和66任务基准测试上的得分。 这两项指标均基于相同的官方单次试验结果计算得出（每个任务5次试验，未评分的试验得分为0，P@1为各任务的平均奖励，P@5为无偏的pass@5估计值，并按任务进行宏平均）；完整数据集的P@1与排行榜上公布的准确率在0.01 0.01范围内一致（差异源于排行榜在我们快照之后重新评分的部分试验）。 GLM 5.2没有TB 4.0的条目，而我们自己的Gemini和Qwen运行结果并非排行榜上的行数据，因此被省略。 对于大多数模型，子集得分略高于完整数据集得分，但两者在模型间的相对表现上高度一致：跨模型而言，在TB 3.0上，Pearson r r（得分的线性一致性）为0.96 0.96（P@1）和0.89 0.89（P@5），在TB 4.0上则为0.97 0.97和0.92 0.92；Spearman ρ \rho（模型排名的相关性）为0.94 0.94 / 0.83 0.83和0.90 0.90 / 0.91 0.91。

paragraphs.en: For ALE-CM the official Agents’ Last Exam leaderboard publishes only aggregate scores per model and harness (mean score and pass rate over the full 152-task benchmark, one run per task) and no per-task results, so Table 16 sets our own Table 2 runs on the 18-task split against the leaderboard’s headline entry for the same model in the same harness family (its default row, the reasoning-effort variant with the highest pass rate, retrieved 2026-09-18). Five frontier rows of Table 2 have such an entry; Claude Sonnet 5, the Gemini Flash models, and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B do not. Because the two sides differ in harness configuration and number of rollouts, agreement is looser than on TB: across the five models Spearman ρ \rho is 0.95 0.95 for pass rate and 0.63 0.63 for score (Pearson r r 0.75 0.75 and 0.56 0.56 ), with Gemini 3.1 Pro the main outlier, scoring far higher in our Gemini CLI runs on the split than on the full benchmark. Close agreement is neither expected nor our aim: the full benchmark spans many domains beyond computing and math, such as engineering, finance, multimodal, and 3D tasks, whereas ALE-CM isolates the one domain our data targets.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 ALE-CM，官方“智能体最终考试”排行榜仅公布每个模型和工具链的汇总得分（即完整 152 项任务的基准测试中的平均得分与通过率，每项任务仅运行一次），而不提供单任务结果。因此，表 16 将我们在 18 项任务子集上运行的表 2 数据，与该排行榜中同一模型、同一工具链家族下的主要条目（其默认行，即通过率最高的推理努力变体，检索于 2026-09-18）进行了对比。 表 2 中有五个前沿模型行包含此类条目；Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini Flash 模型以及 Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B 则没有。 由于双方在工具链配置和运行次数上存在差异，一致性比在 TB 中更弱：在五个模型中，通过率的斯皮尔曼相关系数 ρ 为 0.95，得分的斯皮尔曼相关系数 ρ 为 0.63（皮尔逊相关系数 r 分别为 0.75 和 0.56），其中 Gemini 3.1 Pro 是主要异常值，它在我们的 Gemini CLI 对该子集的运行中得分远高于其在完整基准测试中的得分。 高度一致既非预期结果，也非我们的目标：完整基准测试涵盖了计算和数学之外的多个领域，例如工程、金融、多模态和 3D 任务，而 ALE-CM 仅聚焦于我们数据所针对的单一领域。

paragraphs.en: t11–19 No ancilla file is staged → \to critical-ancilla rule; installs the pinned NumPy/SciPy with uv .
paragraphs.zh: t11–19 未准备辅助文件 → \to 关键辅助文件规则；使用 uv 安装已固定的 NumPy/SciPy。

paragraphs.en: t20–33 Trotterized imaginary-time evolution ( Δ ​ t = 0.0002 \Delta t{=}0.0002 , K = 50000 K{=}50000 ) for the ground state, cross-checked against sparse exact diagonalization: energy − 12.78491 -12.78491 both ways, infidelity 1.0 × 10 − 7 1.0{\times}10^{-7} ; computes a ⁡ ( j ) a(j) , a ⁡ ( j , k ) a(j,k) , V j ​ k V_{jk} , m j m_{j} , H ′ H^{\prime} , H m H_{m} for all 1,024 outcomes by bit-flip indexing.
paragraphs.zh: t20–33 Trotter化虚时演化（Δ t = 0.0002 \Delta t{=}0.0002，K = 50000 K{=}50000）用于计算基态，并与稀疏精确对角化方法交叉验证：两种方法得到的能量均为 −12.78491 -12.78491，不保真度为 1.0 × 10 − 7 1.0{\times}10^{-7}；通过比特翻转索引计算所有 1,024 个结果中的 a ⁡ ( j ) a(j)、a ⁡ ( j , k ) a(j,k)、V j ​ k V_{jk}、m j m_{j}、H ′ H^{\prime} 和 H m H_{m}。

paragraphs.en: t33–36 Verifies shapes and dtypes, unit trace and Hermiticity of every ρ 1 \rho_{1} , correlators recomputed from ρ 1 \rho_{1} ; submits.
paragraphs.zh: t33–36 验证形状和数据类型，每个 ρ 1 \rho_{1} 的单位迹和厄米性，相关子从 ρ 1 \rho_{1} 重新计算；提交。

paragraphs.en: t3–9 Reads specification and config; the ancilla is unstaged; installs the pinned dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: t3–9 读取规格和配置；辅助智能体未部署；安装已固定的依赖项。

paragraphs.en: t20–21 Exact diagonalization ( eigsh ) of the spec Hamiltonian; builds H ′ H^{\prime} and H m H_{m} with the big-endian conventions; checks normalization, Hermiticity and correlator consistency.
paragraphs.zh: t20–21 对特定哈密顿量进行精确对角化（eigsh）；按照大端序约定构建 H ′ H^{\prime} 和 H m H_{m}；检查归一化、厄米性和关联函数一致性。

paragraphs.en: t23–26 Independent reload check: shapes, dtypes, positivity, Hamiltonian residual 8.1 × 10 − 13 8.1{\times}10^{-13} , probability sum 1 − 2 × 10 − 16 1-2{\times}10^{-16} ; submits.
paragraphs.zh: t23–26 独立重载检查：形状、数据类型类型、正性、哈密顿量残差 8.1 × 10 − 13 8.1{\times}10^{-13}，概率总和 1 − 2 × 10 − 16 1-2{\times}10^{-16}；提交。

paragraphs.en: t2–12 Reads the specification; installs NumPy/SciPy into a venv.
paragraphs.zh: t2–12 阅读规范；将 NumPy/SciPy 安装到虚拟环境中。

paragraphs.en: t14 stage1.py builds the site operators with (idx >> b) & 1 where b is a bit mask (512, 256, …), not a bit position, so five of the ten Z j Z_{j} collapse to constants. Its exact diagonalization and its imaginary-time evolution share this table: “infid ED vs XZ: 3.49e-08”, E 0 = − 17.03 E_{0}=-17.03 where the true value is − 12.78 -12.78 .
paragraphs.zh: t14 stage1.py 使用 (idx >> b) & 1 来构建站点算符，其中 b 是一个位掩码（512、256……），而非位位置，因此十个 Z j Z_{j} 中有五个会坍缩为常数。 其精确对角化和虚时演化共享此表：“infid ED vs XZ: 3.49e-08”，E 0 = − 17.03 E_{0}=-17.03，而真实值为 − 12.78 -12.78。

sents.en: t14 stage1.py builds the site operators with (idx >> b) & 1 where b is a bit mask (512, 256, …), not a bit position, so five of the ten Z j Z_{j} collapse to constants.
sents.zh: t14 stage1.py 使用 (idx >> b) & 1 来构建站点算符，其中 b 是一个位掩码（512、256……），而非位位置，因此十个 Z j Z_{j} 中有五个会坍缩为常数。

sents.en: Its exact diagonalization and its imaginary-time evolution share this table: “infid ED vs XZ: 3.49e-08”, E 0 = − 17.03 E_{0}=-17.03 where the true value is − 12.78 -12.78 .
sents.zh: 其精确对角化和虚时演化共享此表：“infid ED vs XZ: 3.49e-08”，E 0 = − 17.03 E_{0}=-17.03，而真实值为 − 12.78 -12.78。

paragraphs.en: t18–32 Writes the protocol; fixes shape bugs caught by | ⟨ X ⟩ | ≤ 1 |\langle X\rangle|\leq 1 checks.
paragraphs.zh: t18–32 编写协议；修复被 | ⟨ X ⟩ | ≤ 1 |\langle X\rangle|\leq 1 检查发现的形状错误。

paragraphs.en: t34–42 “Independent loop-based verification … matches to machine precision … E0 from saved psi_c: -17.0267 (correct ground state).” The check reuses the same operator table, so agreement proves nothing; submits a state with infidelity 0.79 0.79 to the reference.
paragraphs.zh: t34–42 “独立的循环基验证……与机器精度匹配……从保存的 psi_c 得到的 E0：-17.0267（正确的基态）。”该检查重复使用了相同的算符表，因此一致性并不能证明任何问题；它向参考提交了一个不忠度为 0.79 0.79 的状态。

paragraphs.en: t2–14 Reads specification and config; installs the pinned NumPy/SciPy into a uv venv.
paragraphs.zh: t2–14 阅读规格说明和配置；将已固定的 NumPy/SciPy 安装到 uv 虚拟环境中。

paragraphs.en: t16–42 Implements the Trotterized imaginary-time evolution and the vectorized protocol over all 1,024 outcomes; fixes a series of tensor-shape bugs.
paragraphs.zh: t16–42 实现了 Trotter 化的虚时演化以及针对全部 1,024 种结果的向量化协议；修复了一系列张量形状相关的错误。

paragraphs.en: t44–50 A sanity print flags “rho1 hermiticity max err: 0.183”; traces it to its own check ( ρ 1 𝖳 \rho_{1}^{\mathsf{T}} instead of ρ 1 † \rho_{1}^{\dagger} ) and confirms ⟨ Z ⟩ , ⟨ X ⟩ \langle Z\rangle,\langle X\rangle read from ρ 1 \rho_{1} against independently computed correlators to 10 − 15 10^{-15} .
paragraphs.zh: t44–50 合理性检查输出标志为“rho1 厄米性最大误差：0.183”；追踪发现该问题源于自身的检查（使用了 ρ 1 𝖳 \rho_{1}^{\mathsf{T}} 而非 ρ 1 † \rho_{1}^{\dagger}），并确认从 ρ 1 \rho_{1} 读取的 ⟨ Z ⟩ , ⟨ X ⟩ \langle Z\rangle,\langle X\rangle 与独立计算的关联符一致，精度达到 10 − 15 10^{-15}。

paragraphs.en: t54–58 Writes a separate crosscheck.py that rebuilds H H from Kronecker products, takes the ground state with eigsh , re-derives every quantity and compares the saved files : p p 1.1 × 10 − 4 1.1{\times}10^{-4} , ρ 1 \rho_{1} 2.9 × 10 − 4 2.9{\times}10^{-4} , ⟨ Z ⟩ \langle Z\rangle 5.7 × 10 − 4 5.7{\times}10^{-4} , ⟨ X ⟩ \langle X\rangle 3.8 × 10 − 4 3.8{\times}10^{-4} (tolerances 10 − 4 10^{-4} / 10 − 2 10^{-2} ).
paragraphs.zh: t54–58 编写一个独立的 crosscheck.py 文件，该文件通过克罗内克积重新构建 H H，使用 eigsh 获取基态，重新计算所有物理量，并与已保存的文件进行比较：p p 1.1 × 10 − 4 1.1{\times}10^{-4}、ρ 1 \rho_{1} 2.9 × 10 − 4 2.9{\times}10^{-4}、⟨ Z ⟩ \langle Z\rangle 5.7 × 10 − 4 5.7{\times}10^{-4}、⟨ X ⟩ \langle X\rangle 3.8 × 10 − 4 3.8{\times}10^{-4}（容差为 10 − 4 10^{-4} / 10 − 2 10^{-2}）。

paragraphs.en: t60–62 Confirms output files and untouched inputs; submits.
paragraphs.zh: t60–62 确认输出文件和未修改的输入；提交。

paragraphs.en: t13–25 Sets up the venv; writes an assignment-relaxation branch-and-bound with Carpaneto–Toth subtour branching; fixes a stray non-ASCII identifier.
paragraphs.zh: t13–25 设置 venv；编写一个结合 Carpaneto–Toth 子巡回分支法的分配-松弛分支定界算法；修复一个遗漏的非 ASCII 标识符。

paragraphs.en: t29–35 Tiers 1 and 2 proven optimal in 29 and 657 nodes; tier 3 runs in the background.
paragraphs.zh: t29–35 第 1 层和第 2 层在 29 个和 657 个节点中已被证明是最佳选择；第 3 层在后台运行。

paragraphs.en: t39–47 Tier 3 lands at 0.49999 %, “just under the 0.005 threshold” → \to independently recomputes every tour and cost, then confirms tier 1 against an exact Held–Karp dynamic program.
paragraphs.zh: t39–47 第 3 级土地为 0.49999%，“略低于 0.005 的阈值”→ \to 独立地重新计算所有路线和成本，然后使用精确的 Held–Karp 动态规划来确认第 1 级。

paragraphs.en: t51 Writes results.json (tier 3: 172,168 nodes, 100 s); submits.
paragraphs.zh: t51 写入 results.json（第三级：172,168 个节点，100 秒）；提交。

paragraphs.en: t6–16 Subtour-branching solver with Hungarian bounds and directed local search; tier 1 proven optimal in 27 nodes.
paragraphs.zh: t6–16 结合匈牙利界和定向局部搜索的子游分支求解器；在 27 个节点中已证实为 Tier 1 最优解。

paragraphs.en: t19–31 “The first branching scheme is too redundant on Tier 2” → \to finds the bug (already-forced arcs re-branched), makes the partition finite; a Lagrangian bound closes tier 3 immediately.
paragraphs.zh: t19–31 “第一分支方案在 Tier 2 上过于冗余” → \to 发现了该错误（已强制的弧被重复分支），并使划分变为有限；一个拉格朗日界立即关闭了 tier 3。

paragraphs.en: t36–42 Validates every tour and gap by independent recomputation (tier 3 gap 0.2498 %); cleans the temporary runtime; submits.
paragraphs.zh: t36–42 通过独立重新计算验证所有路线和间隙（第 3 级间隙 0.2498%）；清理临时运行时数据；提交。

paragraphs.en: t8–18 Finds SciPy in the system Python; nearest-neighbor + + 2-opt incumbents; benchmarks the Hungarian solver.
paragraphs.zh: t8–18 在系统 Python 中找到 SciPy；最近邻 + + 2-opt 现有解；对匈牙利算法求解器进行基准测试。

paragraphs.en: t24–32 Assignment-bound branch-and-bound with shape, heap-sign and int8-overflow bugs; the pure assignment bound (330 vs. optimum 411.7) leaves a 20 % gap and the 12-city search explodes to 435k nodes.
paragraphs.zh: t24–32 带有形状、堆符号和 int8 溢出错误的分配约束分支定界法；纯分配约束（330 对比最优值 411.7）留下了 20% 的差距，而 12 城市搜索则爆炸式增长至 43.5 万个节点。

paragraphs.en: t40–58 Held–Karp confirms the 12-city optimum; the Lagrangian bound is rewritten four times (dual sign, multipliers stuck at 0, overflow) until at t58 it proves tier 1 at the root and bounds tier 3 at 879.98.
paragraphs.zh: t40–58 Held–Karp 算法确认了 12 城市问题的最优解；拉格朗日界被重写了四次（对偶符号、乘子卡在 0、溢出），直到 t58 时，它在根节点证明了 tier 1，并将界值确定为 tier 3 的 879.98。

paragraphs.en: t60–64 Turns to incumbent heuristics (subtour patching, Or-opt) instead of writing the report; the context window overflows with no results.json .
paragraphs.zh: 第 60–64 轮转而采用现有启发式方法（子巡回修补、Or-opt），而非撰写报告；上下文窗口溢出，且没有 results.json。

paragraphs.en: t2–22 Sets up the venv; generates the instances; verifies genuine asymmetry.
paragraphs.zh: t2–22 设置 venv；生成实例；验证真正的非对称性。

paragraphs.en: t28–36 Best-first branch-and-bound with assignment relaxation: 12 cities in 13 nodes, 20 cities in 378 nodes; notices the reported bound lags the optimum and fixes the bound bookkeeping.
paragraphs.zh: t28–36 带分配松弛的最优优先分支定界法：12 个城市对应 13 个节点，20 个城市对应 378 个节点；注意到所报告的界值落后于最优解，并修正了界值记录。

paragraphs.en: t42–58 Held–Karp DP confirms the 12-city optimum; the plain bound stalls at 1.95 % on 35 cities after 360k nodes → \to a Lagrangian subgradient bound closes tier 3 to 0.0 % in 4 nodes.
paragraphs.zh: t42–58 Held–Karp DP 验证了 12 城市的最佳解；在 35 个城市上，普通界在遍历 36 万个节点后仍停滞于 1.95% → \to 一个拉格朗日子梯度界在 4 个节点内将第 3 层级缩小至 0.0%。

paragraphs.en: t72–84 Writes results.json first, then verifies: independent recomputation of every tour and cost, Held–Karp cross-check for tier 1, an independent heuristic for tier 3, and a determinism re-run (diff only in runtime_seconds ).
paragraphs.zh: t72–84 首先写入 results.json，然后进行验证：对每个路线和成本进行独立重新计算，对 tier 1 执行 Held–Karp 交叉检查，对 tier 3 使用独立的启发式方法，并重新运行确定性流程（差异仅体现在 runtime_seconds 中）。

paragraphs.en: t2–30 Reads the specification; GAP enumeration: for each m m , all abelian groups of order 64 ​ m 64m by elementary divisors, exhaustive check for a cyclic subgroup N N of order m m with quotient ≅ ( ℤ / 4 ) 3 \cong(\mathbb{Z}/4)^{3} → \to 14 extensions.
paragraphs.zh: t2–30 阅读规格说明；GAP 枚举：对于每个 m m，通过初等因子分解出所有阶为 64 ​ m 64m 的阿贝尔群，并穷举检查是否存在一个阶为 m m 的循环子群 N N，使得其商群 ≅ ( ℤ / 4 ) 3 \cong(\mathbb{Z}/4)^{3} → 得到 14 个扩张。

paragraphs.en: t30–31 Product-type classification in Python via Krull–Schmidt: every partition of the elementary-divisor multiset is checked against the five allowed forms → \to 2 non-product extensions ( [ 4 , 4 , 4 , 4 ] [4,4,4,4] , [ 4 , 4 , 4 , 8 ] [4,4,4,8] ).

paragraphs.en: Synthetic corpora for coding and terminal agents. The first wave of agent training data mined real repositories: SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and SWE-Gym ( Pan et al., 2025 ) collect GitHub issues with their tests, and SWE-rebench ( Badertdinov et al., 2025 ) and Skywork-SWE ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) automate the mining. The second wave synthesizes tasks: SWE-smith ( Yang et al., 2025a ) injects bugs into working repositories, SWE-Flow ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) strips a repository along its runtime dependency graph, and R2E-Gym ( Jain et al., 2025 ) back-translates problem statements from commits. Terminal corpora follow the same pattern at larger scale, either with a language model writing tasks, containers, and tests that are then filtered for solvability, as in Endless Terminals ( Gandhi et al., 2026 ) , SETA ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , and recursive solution extension ( Li et al., 2026a ) (TMAX ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) skips this filter and lets RL drop unsolved tasks), or by reconstructing environments from agent trajectories, as in CLI-Gym ( Lin et al., 2026 ) and Terminal-Universe ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . All of these scale the number of instances : each instance is pull-request-sized or a single session, its verifier is a test suite that caps the complexity a task can have, and generation depends on a model whose output must be validated after the fact. We scale environments : a coding agent writes each generator once, the authors review it, and instantiating it involves no model; verification is against the latent world rather than a test suite. Closer in spirit is the programmatic synthesis of executable, stateful tool environments, AutoForge ( Cai et al., 2025 ) , EnvScaler ( Song et al., 2026 ) , ScaleEnv ( Tu et al., 2026 ) , Agent-World ( Dong et al., 2026 ) , EnvFactory ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and LOGIGEN ( Zeng et al., 2026b ) , which also treats the environment as the unit of scale ( Fang et al., 2025 ) ; these are API worlds for short tool-use episodes, and only LOGIGEN emits a progress signal, a per-turn reward from the database’s proximity to its target state. Two findings from that line carry over: more environments alone do not help without difficulty control ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) , and coverage rather than count is what drives transfer ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 用于编码和终端智能体的合成语料库。 第一波智能体训练数据从真实代码仓库中挖掘而来：SWE-bench（Jimenez 等，2024）和 SWE-Gym（Pan 等，2025）收集了附带测试用例的 GitHub 问题，而 SWE-rebench（Badertdinov 等，2025）和 Skywork-SWE（Zeng 等，2025）则实现了挖掘过程的自动化。 第二波数据通过合成任务生成：SWE-smith（Yang 等，2025a）向可用仓库中注入错误，SWE-Flow（Zhang 等，2025b）沿运行时依赖图剥离仓库内容，而 R2E-Gym（Jain 等，2025）则从提交记录中反向翻译问题描述。 终端语料库遵循相同的模式但规模更大：一种方法是由语言模型生成任务、容器和测试用例，再筛选出可解决的问题，如 Endless Terminals（Gandhi 等，2026）、SETA（Shen 等，2026）和递归解决方案扩展（Li 等，2026a）所示（TMAX（Ivison 等，2026）则跳过此筛选步骤，由强化学习自行丢弃未解决的问题）；另一种方法则是根据智能体轨迹重建环境，如 CLI-Gym（Lin 等，2026）和 Terminal-Universe（Wu 等，2026）所示。 所有这些方法都通过扩大实例数量来实现扩展：每个实例的规模相当于一次拉取请求或单个会话，其验证器是一个限制任务复杂度的测试套件，而生成过程则依赖一个需要事后验证输出结果的模型。 我们则通过扩展环境来实现扩展：编码智能体只需为每个生成器编写一次代码，作者会对其进行审核，且实例化过程不涉及任何模型；验证过程基于潜在世界而非测试套件进行。 在理念上更为接近的是可执行、带状态的工具环境的程序化合成方法，包括 AutoForge（Cai 等，2025）、EnvScaler（Song 等，2026）、ScaleEnv（Tu 等，2026）、Agent-World（Dong 等，2026）、EnvFactory（Xu 等，2026）和 LOGIGEN（Zeng 等，2026b），这些方法也将环境视为扩展的基本单位（Fang 等，2025）；它们为短时的工具使用场景提供了 API 世界，其中只有 LOGIGEN 会发出进度信号——即数据库与其目标状态接近程度所对应的每轮奖励。 这一研究方向的两个发现具有延续性：仅增加环境数量而缺乏难度控制并无助于提升效果（Zhu 等，2026b），而覆盖范围而非数量才是推动迁移学习的关键（Chen 等，2026a；Chen 等，2026b；Xu 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our environments differ from this family on the two properties it largely lacks: each spans a long, multi-stage workflow across math and science, ML, and coding and systems domains rather than a short tool-use episode, and every one ships the progress potential Φ W \Phi_{W} of § 3 rather than a bare success condition, so the difficulty control and dense signal these two findings call for come from the same generator that supplies coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的环境与这一类环境在两个关键属性上有所不同，而这些属性正是后者所普遍缺乏的：首先，每个环境都涵盖了数学与科学、机器学习以及编码和系统领域中的漫长多阶段工作流程，而非短暂的工具使用过程；其次，每个环境都包含了第 3 节中提到的进展潜力 Φ W \Phi_{W}，而不仅仅是简单的成功条件。因此，这两项发现所要求的难度控制和密集信号，正是由提供覆盖范围的同一生成器所提供。

paragraphs.en: Backward construction. Latent-world-first synthesis belongs to a long line of methods that derive a task from its solution. Denoising objectives corrupt text and learn to restore it ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) ; the data-cleaning community injects errors of controlled repairability into clean databases to evaluate repair algorithms ( Arocena et al., 2015 ) and corrupts synthetic person records to benchmark record linkage ( Tran et al., 2013 ) ; mutation and bug injection corrupt working code ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Hariharan et al., 2025 ) ; CLI-Gym rewinds a healthy environment to an earlier broken state ( Lin et al., 2026 ) ; instruction back-translation derives prompts from answers ( Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) ; and procedural generators with rule-based verifiers supply unlimited single-turn reasoning problems whose answers are known by construction ( Stojanovski et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . In every case the corrupted object is a single artifact graded by a pre-existing oracle, or a one-step puzzle. We corrupt a rendering of an entire world into many mutually constraining files of different formats, and the oracle is the world itself; this is what lets exactness, and the ground truth of every intermediate stage, survive a multi-hour horizon. In the taxonomy of Zeng et al. (2026a) , generation pipelines anchor on the environment, the task, the trajectory, or a blueprint that coordinates them; anchoring on the verified terminal state itself is what removes the artifact drift among task, environment, and verifier that separately generated factors invite ( Ivanov and Rana, 2026 ) . Concretely, we anchor one level earlier than any object in that taxonomy: the latent world W W itself, so that the task x x , the input tree s 0 s_{0} , the strict verifier ver W \operatorname{ver}_{W} , and the progress potential Φ W \Phi_{W} (Eq. ( 1 )) are four views of one object rather than four artifacts a blueprint must keep synchronized after the fact. CLI-Gym is the closest of these in mechanism, but it rewinds a single running environment to an earlier state and stops at one pass/fail check, with no signal over the stages in between.
paragraphs.zh: 逆向构建。潜在世界优先合成法属于一类长期存在的方法，这些方法从任务的解决方案中推导出任务本身。去噪目标通过破坏文本并学习恢复文本来实现（Lewis 等，2020）；数据清洗领域则向干净的数据库中注入具有可控可修复性的错误以评估修复算法（Arocena 等，2015），并破坏合成的人口记录以基准测试记录关联方法（Tran 等，2013）；突变和错误注入会破坏运行中的代码（Yang 等，2025a；Hariharan 等，2025）；CLI-Gym 会将一个健康的環境回滚到早期的故障状态（Lin 等，2026）；指令反向翻译则从答案中推导出提示（Li 等，2023；Wu 等，2024）；而配备基于规则的验证器的事件生成器，则能生成无限数量的单轮推理问题，其答案在构建时即已知（Stojanovski 等，2025；Chen 等，2025a；Liu 等，2025；Li 等，2025）。在所有这些案例中，被破坏的对象都是一个由预存在的“神谕”或单步谜题进行评分的单一产物。而我们将整个世界的渲染结果破坏为多个相互约束、格式各异的文件，此时“神谕”就是世界本身；正是这一点使得精确性以及每个中间阶段的真实解能够在数小时的时间跨度中得以保留。根据 Zeng 等（2026a）的分类体系，生成流程可以锚定在環境、任务、轨迹或协调这些要素的蓝图上；而锚定在已验证的最终状态本身，则能够消除单独生成的各个因素所引发的任务、環境和验证器之间的产物漂移（Ivanov 和 Rana，2026）。具体而言，我们的锚定点比该分类体系中的任何对象都早一个层级：即潜在世界 W 本身。这样一来，任务 x、输入树 s₀、严格验证器 ver_W 以及进展潜力 Φ_W（公式 (1)）就成为了同一对象的四种不同视角，而非一个蓝图事后必须保持同步的四个独立产物。在机制上，CLI-Gym 与我们的方法最为接近，但它只是将单个运行中的環境回滚到早期状态，并在一次通过/失败检查后停止，无法提供中间各阶段的状态信号。

paragraphs.en: World-state verification, environment scaling, and long-horizon benchmarks. Verifying an agent against the final state of a simulated world rather than against its transcript is established in AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) , τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024a ) , and OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , all with hand-authored tasks for evaluation. Recent work generates the world too: AgentMercury ( Jeong and Yoon, 2026 ) has a model author persistent business worlds with executable invariants, and Zhang et al. (2026) derive dense rewards from progress predicates over generated web sites; neither uses a declared corruption, and both depend on a model to write the world. A growing literature argues that environments are the bottleneck of agentic RL ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Gandhi et al., 2026 ) , with the caveat that more environments alone do not help without difficulty control ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) . Our thesis is narrower: the environments worth scaling are those whose latent world supplies both the oracle and the progress signal. Long-horizon benchmarks with partial credit, TheAgentCompany ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench ( Li et al., 2026b ) , PaperBench ( Starace et al., 2025 ) , MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , and ALE-Bench ( Imajuku et al., 2025 ) , target the regime we train for, but their checkpoints are written per task by hand or graded by a model, and at tens of instances they are evaluation sets.
paragraphs.zh: 世界状态验证、环境扩展与长期基准测试。在 AppWorld（Trivedi 等人，2024）、τ \tau -bench（Yao 等人，2025）、WebArena（Zhou 等人，2024a）和 OSWorld（Xie 等人，2024）中，已确立了将智能体与模拟世界的最终状态进行验证，而非与其转录记录进行验证的方法；这些方法均通过人工编写的任务进行评估。近期的研究也开始生成世界本身：AgentMercury（Jeong 和 Yoon，2026）使用模型来创建具有可执行不变量的持久性商业世界，而 Zhang 等人（2026）则从生成的网站上基于进展谓词推导出密集奖励；这两种方法均未采用声明的破坏机制，且都依赖模型来编写世界。越来越多的文献指出，环境是智能体强化学习的瓶颈（Xi 等人，2025；Fang 等人，2025；Song 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2025a；Gandhi 等人，2026），但需要强调的是，仅增加更多环境本身并无帮助，除非具备难度控制（Zhu 等人，2026b）。我们的论点更为具体：值得扩展的环境是那些其潜在世界同时提供“神谕”和进展信号的环境。具有部分评分的长期基准测试，如 TheAgentCompany（Xu 等人，2024）、Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench（Li 等人，2026b）、PaperBench（Starace 等人，2025）、MLE-bench（Chan 等人，2025）和 ALE-Bench（Imajuku 等人，2025），针对我们训练的目标场景，但它们的检查点要么按任务手动编写，要么由模型进行评分，并且在数十个实例上它们属于评估集。

paragraphs.en: Sparse reward and dense signal in agentic RL. Group-relative methods discard rollout groups with identical rewards ( Yu et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Ivison et al., 2026 ) , schedule prompts by difficulty ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Sha et al., 2026 ) , or seed groups with expert prefixes ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) ; all assume enough solvable prompts to fill a batch. A complementary line moves the tasks rather than the reward, generating or selecting them near the learner’s current success band ( Florensa et al., 2018 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Wolf et al., 2026 ) ; this keeps groups informative but caps difficulty at what the current policy can sometimes finish. Denser signals come from learned or judged step rewards ( Cui et al., 2025 ; Choudhury, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024b ; Gunjal et al., 2025 ) , from advantages over recurring states ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , or from exact but proxy quantities: similarity to an oracle patch ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , the fraction of tests passed ( Du et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) , the count of passing assertions ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , compiler diagnostics ( Zhang and Lanser Contributors, 2025 ) , path-centric credit for evidence gathering ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , or symbolic oracles in closed domains ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Test-fraction rewards are the closest to ours and are what lets SETA and T1 train on terminal tasks, but they score only what the terminal tests probe, are not monotone in workflow progress, and carry no notion of regression. Our potential is exact progress against the latent world at every workflow stage, anchored so that Φ = 1 \Phi=1 exactly when the verifier passes, and free for every seed. A recent finding shapes how such a signal should be used: a shaping term that is not aligned with the task collapses GRPO agents, because in all-fail groups it becomes the whole objective ( Wang, 2026 ) . Unlike the learned or judged step rewards above, Φ \Phi needs no trained critic or LM judge; its relation to classical potential-based shaping ( Ng et al., 1999 ) is discussed in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体强化学习中的稀疏奖励与密集信号。 群体相对方法会丢弃奖励相同的展开组（Yu et al., 2025；He et al., 2025；Ivison et al., 2026），按难度调度提示（Yang et al., 2025b；Sha et al., 2026），或用专家前缀初始化组（Zhang et al., 2025c）；所有方法都假设存在足够多的可解提示来填满一个批次。 一种互补的方法则是调整任务而非奖励，在学习者当前成功区间附近生成或选择任务（Florensa et al., 2018；Guo et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025b；Wolf et al., 2026）；这能保持群体的信息价值，但会将难度限制在当前策略偶尔能够完成的任务水平。 更密集的信号可来自学习或判定的步骤奖励（Cui et al., 2025；Choudhury, 2025；Wang et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2024b；Gunjal et al., 2025），来自相对于重复状态的优势（Feng et al., 2025），或来自精确但代理的量度：与理想补丁的相似度（Wei et al., 2025）、通过测试的比例（Du et al., 2025；Shen et al., 2026）、通过断言的次数（Yang et al., 2026）、编译器诊断信息（Zhang and Lanser Contributors, 2025）、以路径为中心的证据收集信用（Xia et al., 2026），或封闭域中的符号化理想解（Yuan et al., 2026）。 测试比例奖励与我们的方法最为接近，也是 SETA 和 T1 能够在终端任务上进行训练的关键；但它们仅对终端测试所探测的内容进行评分，不会随工作流程的进展而单调变化，且不包含任何回归的概念。 我们的势函数能够精确反映在每个工作流程阶段相对于潜在世界的进展，并通过锚定机制确保当验证器通过时 Φ = 1 \Phi=1，同时适用于所有种子。 一项近期的研究结果影响了此类信号的使用方式：与任务目标不一致的塑形项会导致 GRPO 智能体失效，因为在全部失败的组中，该塑形项会成为整个目标函数（Wang, 2026）。 与上述通过学习或判定获得的步骤奖励不同，Φ \Phi 无需训练好的批评者或语言模型判官；它与经典势函数塑形方法（Ng et al., 1999）的关系将在附录 B 中讨论。

sents.en: Sparse reward and dense signal in agentic RL.
sents.zh: 智能体强化学习中的稀疏奖励与密集信号。

sents.en: Group-relative methods discard rollout groups with identical rewards ( Yu et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Ivison et al., 2026 ) , schedule prompts by difficulty ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Sha et al., 2026 ) , or seed groups with expert prefixes ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) ; all assume enough solvable prompts to fill a batch.
